- Usage: Residence or Manor decor

- How to Obtain: Craft at a Furniture Workshop

2306.name: Calpheon Handcrafted Chair
2306.description:
A Calpheonian woodwork artisan poured his heart into this chair. It is in constant demand especially from the upper class not only because of its beauty but also because of its comfortableness.
- 4-Set Effect: Interior Points +200

- Usage: Residence or Manor decor

- How to Obtain: Craft at a Furniture Workshop

2309.name: Heidelian Handcrafted Sofa
2309.description:
A high-quality sofa made of maple timber covered with sheepskin cushion. It is famous among nobles with its fine finish.
- 4-Set Effect: Interior Points +200

- Usage: Residence or Manor decor

- How to Obtain: Craft at a Furniture Workshop

2311.name: Velian Handcrafted Sofa
2311.description:
A sofa made of thick ash tree. At least four people are required to carry this heavy sofa.
- 4-Set Effect: Interior Points +200

- Usage: Residence or Manor decor

- How to Obtain: Craft at a Furniture Workshop

2313.name: Calpheon Handcrafted Sofa
2313.description:
A tasteful sofa made of Calpheon birch. It is popular among nobles and prelates.
- 4-Set Effect: Interior Points +200

- Usage: Residence or Manor decor

- How to Obtain: Craft at a Furniture Workshop

2315.name: Mediahn Handcrafted Chair
2315.description:
A high-quality chair made of thick white cedar timber with Mediahn traditional patterns. It is very rare because it takes a lot of time to customize.
- 4-Set Effect: Interior Points +200

- Usage: Residence or Manor decor

- How to Obtain: Craft at a Furniture Workshop

2316.name: Mediahn Handcrafted Sofa
2316.description:
A Mediahn traditional sofa made of white cedar. It goes well with light-colored marble house interiors.
- 4-Set Effect: Interior Points +200

- Usage: Residence or Manor decor

- How to Obtain: Craft at a Furniture Workshop

2318.name: Valencian Handcrafted Chair
2318.description:
A chair made of elder tree with delicate decorations. Even though its durability is subpar, it is traded at a quite high price.
- 4-Set Effect: Interior Points +200

- Usage: Residence or Manor decor

- How to Obtain: Craft at a Furniture Workshop

2320.name: Valencian Handcrafted Sofa
2320.description:
A handcrafted sofa made of soft silk carpet and decorated with quality carvings. It is exclusively delivered to the Royal Valencian Palace.
- 4-Set Effect: Interior Points +200

- Usage: Residence or Manor decor

- How to Obtain: Craft at a Furniture Workshop

2381.name: Kamasylvian Commander's Chair
2381.description: A type of chair that was previously made for a military commander of Kamasylvia, and is now available for purchase. It is a very luxurious chair. Rumor has it that this chair was made by an artisan for Hazel Azealia, the Acher military representative. The chair was designed so that it would seem authoritative.

2382.name: Kamasylvian Squared Chair
2382.description: As the name already says every feature of the Kamasylvia Squared Chair has the simple shape of a square. This chair was designed to be easily carried around and to fit everywhere. It comes in both a bright and a dark finish.

2383.name: Kamasylvian Momellies Chair
2383.description: It is said that this was librarian Momellies's favorite chair. It is made by her Fadus friend, from an old ladder. The backrest reflects the beautiful architecture of Grána.

2384.name: Kamasylvian Compact Bench
2384.description: This chair has been simplified and made compact. This chair was designed to be easily carried around and to fit everywhere. It comes in both a bright and a dark finish.

2387.name: Duvencrune Antique Bench
2387.description: It is crafted using wood from Drieghan and was crafted in an old-fashioned style by a skilled woodworker.

2388.name: Duvencrune Wide Bench
2388.description: It is crafted using wood from Drieghan and looks uncomfortable and rough. However, it's actually very comfortable and gives off a delicate wooden scent.

2389.name: Duvencrune Vertical Bench
2389.description: It is crafted using wood from Drieghan. It has a unique design, but still maintains a traditional vibe. Thanks to its comfortable backrest, it is popular among the elderly residents of Drieghan.

2390.name: Duvencrune Vintage Wooden Bench
2390.description: A high quality handmade bench that anyone can sit comfortably on. A lot of time and effort was used to make the Drieghan rough wood smooth.

2391.name: Duvencrune Wooden Memorial Chair
2391.description: A traveler in Drieghan started calling this kind of chair "Memorial Chair" because the it reminded her of a Memorial Stone. The name has now been widely accepted by everyone. It looks good no matter where you put it.

2392.name: Duvencrune Interlocking Chair
2392.description: Unlike most other furniture, the left side and the right side of this chair were crafted separately before being put together into a finished product. It is a traditional chair from Drieghan.

2393.name: Duvencrune Wooden Anvil Chair
2393.description: This simple and lightweight wooden chair has no back support. It has wooden joints that make this chair quite portable. It is especially popular with people from Drieghan who enjoy fishing in the mountains. However, because it is so simple and lightweight, it feels a bit unstable.

2394.name: Duvencrune Wooden Square Chair
2394.description: The structure of this chair has been finely sharped into a square shape by hand. It is heavy and not very portable, but it feels very stable when you sit on it.

2395.name: Kamasylvian Standard Bench
2395.description: A type of bench that was standardized in Kamasylvia and can be found almost everywhere. It is designed to be comfortable for the Ganelle. The Fadus and Papus complain that the bench is to short or that it is too high.

2396.name: Kamasylvian Atanis Bench
2396.description: A bench that has arms and backrest inspired by the shape of the roots of Kamasylve and the melody of Atanis. It is a popular furniture items for those who value beautiful items, like the Ganelle.

2397.name: Kamasylvian Loopy Short Bench
2397.description: A bench made from wood from loop trees, and is characterized by the lack of armrests. It is easy to make and a best-seller. It is similar in appearance to the Kamasylvian Atanis Bench.

2398.name: Kamasylvian Loopy Bench
2398.description: A flat bench made from the wide part of a loopy tree. It can look a little awkward, but once you sit down, it is so comfortable that people find difficult to even get up.

2399.name: Kamasylvian Meeting Chair
2399.description: This type of chair has long been used at the Acher's military representative meetings. Now, ordinary citizens can enjoy this type of chair and it is even exported outside of Kamasylvia. The great care and attention to detail put into making such a chair means that it's beauty lasts for a long time.

2400.name: O'draxxia Hardwood Armchair
2400.description: A rather comfortable chair due to its armrests. Looks a bit rough, yet rather sturdy due to being made with a top quality wood processing technique.

2702.name: Heidelian Handcrafted Bed
2702.description:
A high-quality bed made of Heidelian maple with an oil finish. Rare thick maples have been used to make it. Lie down on it to recover Energy faster.
- Energy Recovery +1 (Online Characters Only)
- Recover 5,000 HP & MP/WP/SP
- 4-Set Effect: Interior Points +200

- Usage: Residence or Manor decor

- How to Obtain: Craft at a Furniture Workshop

2704.name: Velian Handcrafted Bed
2704.description:
A bed made of processed Velian ash tree. Even though its finish is a bit clumsy, it does its job. Lie down on it to recover Energy faster.

- 4-Set Effect: Interior Points +200

2846.description: A Chandelier crafted from Thuja Trees that grow in Duvencrune. The furniture artisan who originally designed this item is known to have inscribed the word 'Sunset' on the corner of its support fixture. Its sturdiness makes it popular among many people.

3565.description:
A decoration that can be installed in your residence.
Interacting with this item will give you a buff and consume its Durability.
- Special Function: Sailing Mastery +100 for 4 hr upon use

- Usage: Residence or Manor decor

- How to Obtain: Craft at a Furniture Workshop

3577.name: [Manor] Rearing Golden Horse Fountain
3577.description:
A three-tiered fountain with a magnificent golden horse rearing at the top. A great piece of outdoor ornament to add to the sense of grandeur to the manor. This fountain can only be owned by riders that have ridden their steeds towards a great goal.

- Usage: Manor decor

- How to Obtain: Craft at a Furniture Workshop

3578.name: [Manor] Leaping Golden Deer Fountain
3578.description:
A three-tiered fountain with a golden deer leaping towards the sky and touching the clouds. A great outdoor ornament to add a sense of grandeur to the manor. This fountain can only be owned by veteran hunters.

- Usage: Manor decor

- How to Obtain: Craft at a Furniture Workshop

3579.name: [Manor] Dreaming Golden Mermaid Fountain
3579.description:
A three-tiered fountain with a realistic singing golden mermaid. A great piece of outdoor ornament to add to the sense of grandeur to the manor. This fountain can only be owned by outstanding treasure hunters of the seas.

- Usage: Manor decor

- How to Obtain: Craft at a Furniture Workshop

3585.name: [Manor] Starspun Chandelier
3585.description:
A Starspun Chandelier that was crafted in the Ancient Kingdom of Orzeca. According to records, it was made by a father for his daughter who loved to go out every night to see the stars after hearing that her mother, who died when she was young, became a star. However, a prophecy from an astrologist - that his daughter would meet her end on a night she ventured out - led the father to craft this chandelier so she'd never have to leave the safety of their home.

- Usage: Manor decor

- How to Obtain: Craft at a Furniture Workshop

3586.name: [Manor] Sunflare Chandelier
3586.description:
A Sunflare Chandelier crafted in the Ancient Kingdom of Orzeca. According to records, a father crafted it for his son who was turning pale. This was because the family was prohibited from seeing the sun due to the grave sins they have committed.

- Usage: Manor decor

- How to Obtain: Craft at a Furniture Workshop

3587.name: [Manor] Herald of Dawn Fireplace
3587.description:
A Fireplace crafted in Crow's Nest. It's a special fireplace decorated with a mirror imbued with the flame and spirit of Hesed's Crystal. You can see the following text written when you look closely.

"Never forget the reason you can stay in the highest places is because the ones below are supporting you and that countless sacrifices were made to become the center of the world. Look into the mirror every morning and repent for the person you were yesterday then start the day anew. Never forget that we are all fulfilling our important purpose in life even if we don't appear to be important beings to the outside world."

- Usage: Manor decor

- How to Obtain: Craft at a Furniture Workshop

3590.name: [Manor] Handcrafted Ancient Kingdom Bookshelf
3590.description:
A Handcrafted Ancient Kingdom Bookshelf that was restored by Denulo, the gravekeeper at Crypt of Resting Thoughts in O'dyllita. Its luxurious gold decorations really stand out. It contains records about the everyday life stories, culture, and hopes of the people in Orzeca. However, parts of the texts cannot be interpreted as they are written in an ancient language that isn't native to Orzeca.

- Usage: Manor decor

- How to Obtain: Craft at a Furniture Workshop

3591.name: [Manor] Aal's Sanctuary Wall Candle Stand
3591.description:
An Aal's Sanctuary Candle Stand crafted by the artisan craftsman of the Royal Palace of Valencia. It was used to light the secret basement below the royal palace used in war time. It is said to be used to pray for sanctuary.

- Usage: Manor decor

- How to Obtain: Processing (Manufacture) - Manufacture with the following materials

- Materials:
 Aal's Sanctuary Candle Stand x1
 Delotia-scented Candle x3

3595.name: [Manor] Runn Lamp
3595.description:
A lamp that was used to light the currently deserted city of Runn back in the day. Runn Light Fragment, created from the Inextinguishable Stone, never burns out and stays bright throughout the night.

- Usage: Manor decor

- How to Obtain: Craft at a Furniture Workshop

3596.name: [Manor] Skabiosa's Gazebo
3596.description:
Skabiosa, the work supervisor in Kamasylvia, was shocked to find out that people coined the term "Skabiosa's midnight oil" as she was infamous for working day and night without rest. She then decided to go to Lake Flondor and rest, but she went all the way down to Okiara River where she was inspired to build the Skabiosa's Gazebo. Skabiosa made it to represent the winds of the forest and the flow of the river.

- Usage: Manor decor

- How to Obtain: Craft at a Furniture Workshop

3604.name: [Manor] Olvian Bookshelf
3604.description:
An Olvian Bookshelf crafted by Wocester, the Olvian furniture dealer. He said he crafted the furniture while reminiscing about the charming, timeless town of Olvia. Both Sturdy Maple and Pine Plywood were used to make this furniture, but the grain on each piece of wood matches the others perfectly. You can truly feel Wocester's fondness for Olvia.

- Usage: Manor decor

- How to Obtain: Craft at a Furniture Workshop

3605.name: [Manor] Olvian Sofa
3605.description:
An Olvian Sofa crafted by Wocester, the Olvian furniture dealer. He said he crafted the furniture while reminiscing about the charming, timeless town of Olvia. Both Sturdy Maple and Pine Plywood were used to make this furniture, but the grain on each piece of wood matches the others perfectly. You can truly feel Wocester's fondness for Olvia.

- Usage: Manor decor

- How to Obtain: Craft at a Furniture Workshop

3607.name: [Manor] Olvian Wardrobe
3607.description:
An Olvian Wardrobe crafted by Wocester, the Olvian furniture dealer. He said he crafted the furniture while reminiscing about the charming, timeless town of Olvia. Both Sturdy Maple and Pine Plywood were used to make this furniture, but the grain on each piece of wood matches the others perfectly. You can truly feel Wocester's fondness for Olvia.

3610.name: [Manor] Olvian Bed
3610.description:
An Olvian Bed crafted by Wocester, the Olvian furniture dealer. He said he crafted the furniture while reminiscing about the charming, timeless town of Olvia. Both Sturdy Maple and Pine Plywood were used to make this furniture, but the grain on each piece of wood matches the others perfectly. You can truly feel Wocester's fondness for Olvia.

- Usage: Manor decor

3613.name: [Manor] Little Sun
3613.description:
The Little Sun was used to light the Calpheon Slum. The Inextinguishable Stone, a rare product of numerous alchemical experiments, shines bright like the sun even at night.

- Usage: Manor decor

- How to Obtain: Processing (Manufacture) - Manufacture with the following materials

- Materials:
 Alchemist's Lamp x1
 Inextinguishable Stone x1

3619.name: [Manor] Flondor Pond
3619.description:
A Grándiha style outdoor stone structure with fresh Apu Apu Waterstarwort planted in it. You can smell the flowery fragrance of Vedelona, and running your hand slowly through the leaves and the cold water reminds you of being at Lake Flondor.

- Usage: Manor decor

- How to Obtain: Craft at a Furniture Workshop

3620.name: [Manor] Lion's Reach Fountain
3620.description:
A northern Heidelian style water fountain that was put out of production after Serendia was conquered by Calpheon. In the past, it was used in ceremonies where someone returning from war would wash their bodies of the stench of their enemies and swear upon the peace of Serendia before an audience with the king. You can read the following text when looking at it closely.

"Be always vigilant like a lion"

- Usage: Manor decor

- How to Obtain: Craft at a Furniture Workshop

3626.name: [Manor] Stella's Hope Ornament
3626.description:
A vase made by Izella in Florin for the adventurer that shared in the pains with her son, Stella. The bouquet of Vedelona in the vase is giving off a pleasant scent. Much like the sincere hopes of Stella for someone, the flowers effuse sentimentality.

- Usage: Manor decor

- How to Obtain: Processing (Manufacture) - Simple Alchemy with the following ingredients

- Ingredients:
 Vilentia's Vedelona Bouquet x1
 Vase of Florin's Hope x1

3627.name: [Manor] Glory of Heidel
3627.description:
An Indomitable Lion statue that was only awarded to the great heroes of Serendia. The lion appears so grand and powerful that none other than a great hero can meet its gaze.

- Usage: Manor decor

- How to Obtain: Craft at a Furniture Workshop

3629.name: [Manor] Stonetail Outdoor Shed
3629.description:
A Stonetail outdoor shed that makes clip-clops noises when the wind blows through. The shed stays cool even in the blazing mid-day heat. Lying inside the shed, you can feel the warmth of the countryside blown in on the breeze.

- Usage: Manor decor

- How to Obtain: Craft at a Furniture Workshop

3701.name: Alchemy Tool
3701.description:
A tool that can reconstruct the components in a substance.

- Usage: Residence or Manor decor

- How to Obtain #1: Purchase from a General Goods Shop

- How to Obtain #2: Craft at a Level 2 Tool Workshop

- Materials:
Rough Stone x18
Melted Iron Shard x10
Black Stone Powder x3

3703.description:

- Usage: Residence or Manor decor

- Effect:

- How to Obtain: Craft at a Level 4 Tool Workshop

- Materials:
Polished Stone x30
Usable Scantling x15
Melted Iron Shard x24

- How to Repair: Press the "Repair" button on the Advanced Alchemy Tool installed in your residence. This will consume Lomerun's Advanced Alchemy Repair Tool x1 from your inventory to fully repair its Durability.

- Lomerun's Advanced Alchemy Repair Tool can be exchanged for Advanced Alchemy Tool x1 through <Wandering Alchemist> Dalishain, found in each town.

3705.name: Anvil
3705.description:
A tool used for Repairing weapons and Defense Gear. It requires knowledge about Self Repairing to be used.
- It can be installed in a residence.

3717.description:

The hot spring water relieves you of all tension and calms your nerves with the added effect of the morning mist that clears your mind of all its worries. - How to Obtain #1: Processing (Manufacture) Grinding with certain Crystals and Black Stone

- How to Obtain #2: Crafting at a Refinery

4902.name: Alluvial Gold
4902.description:
A rare ingredient filtered from river water that can be heated to create gold.

- How to Obtain: Filtering (Bottle of River Water)

4906.name: Grade 1 Weapon Reform Stone
4906.description:
This reform stone can be used when attempting to reform a weapon.

- How to Obtain: Crafting at a Refinery

You can upgrade items by summoning the Black Spirit.
Right-click to start item reform.
If successful, the reformed item will have a higher grade and better stats.
※ One reform stone will be consumed per item reform attempt.

4907.name: Grade 1 Armor Reform Stone
4907.description:

- How to Obtain: Crafting at a Refinery

※ One reform stone will be consumed per item reform attempt.

4910.description:

You can upgrade items by summoning the Black Spirit.
Right-click to start item reform.
※ If successful, the reformed item will have a higher grade and better stats.
One reform stone will be consumed per item reform attempt.

<Crafting Method>
Heating (Grade 3 Weapon Reform Stone x10, Sharp Black Crystal Shard x1) = Ultimate Weapon Reform Stone

4911.name: Grade 3 Armor Reform Stone
4911.description:
A material needed for Grade 3 Armor Reform. Upgrading armor allows you to unleash their potential.

- How to Obtain: Crafting at a Refinery, Exchange Hunter's Seal x5 with Thyshelle Arms (Jeweler of Tarif).

You can upgrade items by summoning the Black Spirit.
Right-click to start item reform.
※ One reform stone will be consumed per item reform attempt.
If successful, the reformed item will have a higher grade and better stats.

<Crafting Method>
Heating (Grade 3 Weapon Reform Stone x10, Sharp Black Crystal Shard x1)

4912.name: Ultimate Weapon Reform Stone
4912.description:
This reform stone can be used when attempting to reform a weapon.

- Usage: Item Reform

- How to Obtain: Crafting at a Refinery or exchange Hunter's Seal

- How to Use:
You can upgrade items by summoning the Black Spirit.
You will have a 100% chance of successfully reforming an item.
Right-click to start item reform.

※ One reform stone will be consumed per reform attempt and items can be reformed up to "Ultimate", which increases the items effects. "Ultimate" items cannot be reformed any further.

4913.name: Ultimate Armor Reform Stone
4913.description:
This reform stone can be used when attempting to reform armor.

- Usage: Item Reform

- How to Obtain: Crafting at a Refinery or exchange Hunter's Seal

- How to Use:
You can upgrade items by summoning the Black Spirit.
You will have a 100% chance of successfully reforming an item.
Right-click to start item reform.

※ One reform stone will be consumed per reform attempt and items can be reformed up to "Ultimate", which increases the items effects. "Ultimate" items cannot be reformed any further.

4914.name: Aal's Tear
4914.description:
Tears of the Valencian god.

- You can sell it to the local vendor at the same price as the purchase price.

4915.name: Manos Stone
4915.description:
A legendary polishing master's soul is housed in this stone.

- An ingredient for making Manos accessories and equipment.

- How to Obtain: Purchase from jewelers

4916.name: Blue Reagent
4916.description:
Seilane's years of research came to fruition to make this product.

- Usage: Craft Blue-Grade Elixirs

- Crafting Method: Processing (Manufacture) - Simple Alchemy

- Ingredients:
Green-Grade Elixir x3
Blue Reagent x1

- How to Obtain: Purchase from NPC Vendors

4917.name: Forest Fury
4917.description:
The fury of the forest pent up over the years is contained within.

※ Use Simple Alchemy in Processing to combine Black Magic Crystal - Harphia, Black Magic Crystal - Cobelinus, Black Magic Crystal - Viper, Black Magic Crystal - Hystria, Black Magic Crystal - Carmae, or Black Magic Crystal - Addis with Magical Shard to turn the crystal into a JIN, BON, or WON.

※ Category: Material
※ Main Usage: Craft crystals that can be transfused into gear for additional effects

4918.name: Magical Shard
4918.description:
A fragment surrounded with black magic.

- Usage: Craft Manos Processing Stone, Manos Accessory, BON Magic Crystals, WON Magic Crystals, etc.

- How to Obtain: Processing (Manufacture) - Heating with the following materials

- Materials:
Yellow-grade Black Magic Crystal x1

※ You can Mass Process with Sealed Black Magic Crystal x10 and Black Stone Powder x1 per batch.

4919.name: Piece of Image
4919.description:
A substance that remembers the images of things with the power of Merindora, the oldest spirit in existence.

 - Usage: Craft Peridot Forest Path Wagon

 - How to Obtain: Processing (Manufacture) - Simple Alchemy with the following materials

 - Crafting Materials:
Merindora's Element x1
Trace of Nature x300
Weeds x100

4921.name: Blueprint: Epheria Frigate
4921.description:
A partial blueprint for a frigate. You will need several of these to build a frigate.

- Usage: Build Epheria Frigate
You can build an Epheria Frigate via Port Epheria 3-5, 2F's Shipyard.

- How to Obtain: Recurring quest reward via Port Epheria's Philaberto Falasi

4922.name: Old Moon Anti-Corrosive
4922.description:
Anvils made light and portable specifically for field usage corrode easily. Old Moon Anti-Corrosive can temporarily delay corrosion. Only the alchemists of the Old Moon Guild can make this anti-corrosive.

 - Usage: Craft Old Moon Camping Anvil

 - How to Obtain: Purchase from Old Moon Manager

4923.name: Merindora's Element
4923.description:
An element that houses the wish of Merindora, the oldest spirit. Combine big batches of Trace of Nature and Weed to synthesize Piece of Image.

- Usage: Craft Piece of Image for Peridot Forest Path Wagon

- Crafting Method: Processing (Manufacture) - Simple Alchemy

- Piece of Image Crafting Materials:
Merindora's Element x1
Trace of Nature x300
Weeds x100

- How to Obtain: Family quest [Wagon] Flondor Goose Spirit reward or exchange 10 Balenos, Serendia, Calpheon, Mediah, or Valencia Meals via Merindora in Grána

4924.name: Mystical Spirit Powder
4924.description:
A mysterious powder. It is used to recharge alchemy stones.

- Usage: Recharge alchemy stone

- Recharge Amount: 1
- Required Amount
Vell's Heart: x2
Khan's Heart: x2

- Recharge Amount: 4
- Required Amount
Imperfect alchemy stone: x1
Sturdy alchemy stone: x4
Sharp alchemy stone: x5
Resplendent alchemy stone: x6
Splendid alchemy stone: x7
Shining alchemy stone: x8

- How to Obtain: Processing (Manufacture) - Grinding with the following material
Spirit Stone x1

- However, you cannot use Grinding on Spirit Stones crafted via Alchemy.

4925.name: Tears of the Falling Moon
4925.description:
A draught researched and created by Alustin, Gorgath and Freharau while staying at the Holy College of Calpheon. It has many of the properties of the legendary Philosopher's Stone. The alchemists of the Old Moon Guild have managed to mass produce and sell it.

- Crafting Method: Processing (Manufacture) - Simple Alchemy

- Usage #1: Craft Verdure Draught

- Crafting Materials:
Worker's Elixir x3
Elixir of Swiftness x3
Elixir of Time x3
Tears of the Falling Moon x1

- Usage #2: Craft Beast's Draught

- Crafting Materials:
Grim Reaper's Elixir x3
EXP Elixir x3
Elixir of Will x3
Tears of the Falling Moon x1

- Usage #3: Craft Giant's Draught

- Crafting Materials:
Elixir of Fury x3
Elixir of Shock x3
Elixir of Perforation x3
Tears of the Falling Moon x1

- Usage #4: Craft Savage Draught

- Crafting Materials:
Weenie Elixir x3
Looney Elixirx3
Helix Elixir x3
Tears of the Falling Moon x1

- Usage #5: Craft Frenzy Draught

- Crafting Materials:
Abyssal Essence x1
Elixir of Demihuman Huntx3
Elixir of Frenzy x3
Tears of the Falling Moon x1

※ Higher grade versions of the same elixir can be used as a substitute at a 1:3 ratio.

- How to Obtain: Purchase from Old Moon Managers (Klau, Stee, Lajee, Jak, and Zya)

4986.name: Ibellab's Essence
4986.description:
An essence taken from the Ibellab Oasis that works as an excellent catalyst for alchemical reactions. It is a major sources of profit for Old Moon Merchants, and is sold in many locations. It can be purchased from a Material Vendor and can be used with Simple Alchemy.

- Usage: Mass Process Elixirs, Draughts, and Perfumes if at least Alchemy Skilled 1

- Crafting Method: Processing (Manufacture) - Simple Alchemy

- Materials:
Elixirs, Draughts, or Perfumes Crafting Materials x10
Ibellab's Essence x1

- How to Obtain: Purchase from Material Vendor or Old Moon Manager in any town or city.

4987.name: Concentrated Magical Black Gem
4987.description:
A crystallized form of concentrated dark energy. It is used for enhancing a certain type of equipment. More black gems are required for enhancement at higher enhancement levels.

- Usage: Enhance Life Skill gear and accessories

- Enhancements with this item will not be affected by your Enhancement Chance.

- How to Obtain: Processing (Manufacture) - Simple Alchemy with the following materials

- Materials #1:
Black Gem x5
Sharp Black Crystal Shard x2

- Materials #2:
Black Gem x50
Sharp Black Crystal Shard x20
Black Stone Powder x1

- Materials #3:
Black Gem x500
Sharp Black Crystal Shard x200
Pure Powder Reagent x1

4988.name: Black Essence: Addis
4988.description:
The concentrated essence of Black Energy.

- Usage: Heating with Ancient Magic Crystal - Addis to obtain a Black Magic Crystal - Addis.

- How to Obtain: Exchange Golden Seals in Manage Currency.

4989.name: Red Essence
4989.description:
The concentrated essence of red blood.

- Usage: Craft Red Battlefield Crystals

- Crafting Method: Processing (Manufacture) - Heating

- Materials:
Red Essence x1
- Choose one of the following:
Black Spirit Crystal
Ancient Magic Crystal of Crimson Flame - Power
Ancient Magic Crystal - Harphia
Ancient Magic Crystal - Cobelinus
Ancient Magic Crystal - Viper
Ancient Magic Crystal - Hystria
Ancient Magic Crystal - Carmae
Ancient Magic Crystal - Addis

- How to Obtain: Exchange Battlefield Tokens obtained from the Red Battlefield via Manage Currency

4990.name: Black Essence: Black Spirit Crystal
4990.description:

- Usage: Heating with Black Spirit Crystal to obtain an Awakened Spirit's Crystal.

- How to Obtain: Exchange Golden Seals via the Manage Currency UI.

4996.name: Black Essence

Ancient Magic Crystal - Harphia
Ancient Magic Crystal - Cobelinus
Ancient Magic Crystal - Viper
Ancient Magic Crystal - Hystria
Ancient Magic Crystal - Carmae

4997.name: Hard Black Crystal Shard
4997.description:
A crystal shard that is clouded by an unknown energy. Merchants will buy it at a high price.

- Usage: Exchange for Sharp Black Crystal Shard with the Black Spirit.

- How to Obtain: All Gathering activities according to a set probability

4998.name: Sharp Black Crystal Shard
4998.description:

- Crafting Method: Processing (Manufacture) - Heating

- Usage #1: Craft Concentrated Magical Black Stone
(Enhance PRI (I) or higher weapons and defense gear)

- Crafting Materials:
Sharp Black Crystal Shard x1
Black Stone x2

- Usage #2: Craft Flawless Magical Black Stone
(Enhance Blackstar gear)

- Crafting Materials:
Sharp Black Crystal Shard x2
Mass of Pure Magic x1

- Usage #3: Craft Flawless Chaotic Black Stone
(Enhance Slumbering Origin armor)

- Crafting Materials:
Sharp Black Crystal Shard x2
Mass of Pure Magic x1
Caphras Stone x10

Usage #4: Craft Black Stone x1-5

- Crafting Method: Processing (Manufacture) - Grinding

- Crafting Materials:

※ You can Mass Process with 10x the usual amount of materials and 1 Black Stone Powder per batch.

- How to Obtain: All Gathering activities according to a set probability

Black Stone x2

- Materials #2:

Black Stone Powder x1

- Materials #3:

Pure Powder Reagent x1

- Usage: Craft various Alchemy materials & elixirs or House Crafting

- How to Obtain: Lumbering (rarely from trees), Exploration Node - Lumbering

5101.name: Golden Horse Statue
5101.description:
A glorious statue that is only given to riders that have a proven record in the Grand Prix. The statue signifies the dignity and strength of an outstanding steed. The statue was crafted at the Stonetail Horse Ranch for riders to cherish the precious moments they spent racing toward the same goal with their trusty steed.

 - How to Obtain:
 You can exchange Grand Prix Gold Trophy x3, Grand Prix Silver Trophy x7, Grand Prix Bronze Trophy x15, or Grand Prix Participant Certificate x25 for it through Gula at Stonetail Horse Ranch.

5102.name: Golden Deer Statue
5102.description:
A statue given to those that understand the bitter suffering in Kamasylvia Forest or have recovered the wishstones in Narcion for Narc. It is also given to hunters that were recognized as someone with outstanding Hunting skills. The statue depicts a golden deer leaping toward the sky and touching the clouds.

 - How to Obtain:
 Exchange Narc's Wishstone x10 or Hunter's Token x150 through Lejenti in Narcion.

 Exchange Mournful Crystal of the Forest x20 or Hunter's Token x150 through Remitaronsom in Tooth Fairy Cabin.

5103.name: Golden Mermaid Statue
5103.description:
The statue is one of the Slippery Scallywags' most precious treasures that sunk to the bottom of the deep ocean in the Slippery Scallywags Treasure Chest. It is still a mystery as to why the mermaid statue is so precious to them or why they stored it like this. Whatever the case may be, an old legend tells of how the mermaid comes alive and sings on the night the largest moon blooms.

 - How to Obtain: Slight chance to get the statue by opening the Slippery Scallywags Treasure Chest sunken deep in the ocean near the Slippery Scallywags Den with the Clickety-clack Key at a set probability

5104.name: First Tier of the Fountain
5104.description:
The first tier of a three-tiered fountain that can be installed outdoors at the manor. It was made extremely sturdy as to withstand the immense weight. It the bottom tier of the fountain.

- Usage: Craft the following [Manor] Fountains
 [Manor] Rearing Golden Horse Fountain
 [Manor] Leaping Golden Deer Fountain
 [Manor] Dreaming Golden Mermaid Fountain

- How to Obtain: Craft at a Furniture Workshop

5105.name: Second Tier of the Fountain
5105.description:
The second tier of a three-tiered fountain that can be installed outdoors at the manor. It was made extremely sturdy as to withstand the immense weight. It the middle tier of the fountain and plays an important role in pumping the water.

- Usage: Craft the following [Manor] Fountains
 [Manor] Rearing Golden Horse Fountain
 [Manor] Leaping Golden Deer Fountain
 [Manor] Dreaming Golden Mermaid Fountain

- How to Obtain: Craft at a Furniture Workshop

5106.name: Third Tier of the Fountain
5106.description:
The third tier of a three-tiered fountain that can be installed outdoors at the manor. It was made extremely sturdy as to withstand the immense weight. It was made to support the iconic statue at the top and spout the water in the fountain.

- Usage: Craft the following [Manor] Fountains
 [Manor] Rearing Golden Horse Fountain
 [Manor] Leaping Golden Deer Fountain
 [Manor] Dreaming Golden Mermaid Fountain

- How to Obtain: Craft at a Furniture Workshop

5107.name: Flawless Spirit's Mirror
5107.description:
A Flawless Spirit's Mirror crafted by a crow with a golden touch that resides on Crow's Nest. It is a mirror imbued with the breath of the water, land, tree, and earth ancient spirits. It has absolutely no flaws and dimly glows throughout the entire day.

- Usage: Craft [Manor] Herald of Dawn Fireplace

- How to Obtain: Complete [Manor] daily quest via Lavala in Crow's Nest

5108.name: Master Crow's Fireplace Mantle
5108.description:
A Master Crow's Fireplace Mantle crafted by a Crow with a golden touch that resides on Crow's Nest. The words that tell you to remember all the one supporting you to stay at the highest places are engraved on it.

- Usage: Craft [Manor] Herald of Dawn Fireplace

- How to Obtain: Complete [Manor] daily quest via Lavala in Crow's Nest

5109.name: Master Crow's Fireplace Surround
5109.description:
A Master Crow's Fireplace Surround crafted by a Crow with a golden touch that resides on Crow's Nest. The words that tell you to remember the countless sacrifices that were made for you to become the center of the world are engraved on it.

- Usage: Craft [Manor] Herald of Dawn Fireplace

- How to Obtain: Complete [Manor] daily quest via Lavala in Crow's Nest

5110.name: Master Crow's Fireplace Overmantel
5110.description:
A Master Crow's Fireplace Overmantel crafted by a Crow with a golden touch that resides on Crow's Nest. The Flawless Spirit's Mirror can be installed on it. The words that tell you to remember to look into the mirror every morning and repent for the person you were yesterday then start the day anew are engraved on it.

- Usage: Craft [Manor] Herald of Dawn Fireplace

- How to Obtain: Complete [Manor] daily quest via Lavala in Crow's Nest

5111.name: Master Crow's Fireplace Pillar
5111.description:
A Master Crow's Fireplace Pillar crafted by a Crow with a golden touch that resides on Crow's Nest. The words that tell you to never forget that we are all fulfilling our important purpose in life even if we don't appear to be important beings to the outside world are engraved on it.

- Usage: Craft [Manor] Herald of Dawn Fireplace

- How to Obtain: Complete [Manor] daily quest via Lavala in Crow's Nest

5113.name: Crown of Honor
5113.description:
A Crown of Honor embedded with blood rubies and indigo lapis lazuli. It was crafted by a venerable noble family said to have resided on the grounds prior to the erection of the Elion Church in Heidel.

- Usage: Craft [Manor] Glory of Serendia Wall Decor
Arrange Crown of Honor and Lion that Serenades the Sun into a [I] shape to combine them.

- How to Obtain: Craft at a Furniture Workshop

5115.name: Restored Orzeca Bookshelf
5115.description:
A bookshelf that was discovered at the Crypt of Resting Thoughts in O'dyllita. It appears to have been crafted in the style of the Ancient Kingdom of Orzeca. Denulo, the gravekeeper, was involved in restoring it.

- Usage: Craft [Manor] Handcrafted Ancient Kingdom Bookshelf

- How to Obtain: Complete [Manor] daily quest via Denulo in Crypt of Resting Thoughts

5116.name: Restored Orzeca Golden Crown Decoration
5116.description:
A golden crown decoration that was discovered at the Crypt of Resting Thoughts in O'dyllita. It appears to have been crafted in the style of the Ancient Kingdom of Orzeca and thought to have been used to decorate a bookshelf. Denulo, the gravekeeper, was involved in restoring it.

- Usage: Craft [Manor] Handcrafted Ancient Kingdom Bookshelf

- How to Obtain: Complete [Manor] daily quest via Denulo in Crypt of Resting Thoughts

5117.name: Aal's Sanctuary Candle Stand
5117.description:
An Aal's Sanctuary Candle Stand crafted by the artisan craftsman of the Royal Palace of Valencia. It was used to light the secret basement below the royal palace used in war time. It is said to be used to pray for sanctuary.

- Usage: Craft [Manor] Aal's Sanctuary Wall Candle Stand

- How to Obtain: Bring Golden Mane Glass Vase to the bookseller Kiyak in Valencia and complete the [Manor] Birth of Ibellab Oasis

 ※ Golden Mane Glass Vase can be obtained with a low chance by fishing at Ibellab Oasis.

5120.name: Alchemist's Lamp
5120.description:
A lamp containing the Inextinguishable Stone. It might have gotten its name because an alchemist crafted the Inextinguishable Stone and helped many in need.

- Usage: Craft [Manor] Little Sun

- How to Obtain: Craft at a Furniture Workshop

5121.name: Charred Stone
5121.description:
A stone charred by fire. Unfortunately, there's no energy within in this stone. However, Yisar Pjetyo the Alchemist in Tarif might be able to bring back the stone's energy.

- Usage: Exchange for Inextinguishable Stone

- How to Obtain: Perform Alchemy in your residence with the following ingredients

- Ingredients:
 Powder of Flame x10
 Processed Coal x10
 Oil of Fortitude x 10
 Shining Powder x10
 Black Gem Fragment x10

5122.name: Inextinguishable Stone
5122.description:
A strange stone that pierces the darkness with its everlasting radiance. This may sound odd, but there are no ways to craft it with 100% accuracy. It can be crafted on rare occasions based on the information written about the stone after you get the knowledge of Inextinguishable Stone left behind by an unknown alchemist. Children called this stone the Little Sun.

- Usage #1: Craft [Manor] Little Sun

- Usage #2: Craft Runn Light Fragment

- How to Obtain: Exchange Charred Stone x100 with the alchemist Yisar Pjetyo in Tarif or obtain at a low chance via Alchemy with the following ingredients

- Materials:
Black Gem Fragment x10
Powder of Flame x10
Processed Coal x10
Oil of Fortitude x10
Shining Powder x10

5123.name: Lamp Post
5123.description:
A post that supports an Alchemist's Small Lamp containing a Runn Light Fragment. Its uncanny form is visible from a distance.

- Usage: Craft [Manor] Runn Lamp

- How to Obtain: Craft at a Furniture Workshop

5124.name: Alchemist's Small Lamp
5124.description:
A lamp with "small" included in its name in honor of the alchemist who made the Inextinguishable Stone, from which Runn Light Fragment was originated.

- Usage: Craft [Manor] Runn Lamp

- How to Obtain: Craft at a Furniture Workshop

5125.name: Runn Light Fragment
5125.description:
A new type of substance that the all grown-up children in the slums crafted from the Inextinguishable Stone invented by an alchemist. They made Runn Light Fragment bigger and more radiant than the Inextinguishable Stone, based on their research of the stone. Only those with the knowledge of Runn Light Fragment can craft it.

- Usage: Craft [Manor] Runn Lamp

- How to Obtain: Perform Alchemy in your residence with the following ingredients

- Ingredients:
 Inextinguishable Stone x1
 Cleansed Magical Black Stone x1
 Stabilized Magical Black Stone x1

5126.name: Flondor Breeze Ceiling
5126.description:
The item was created by Skabiosa, the work supervisor of Kamasylvia, who was inspired by the winds of the forest blowing softly along Lake Flondor. It is used as a part of Skabiosa's Gazebo.

- Usage: Craft [Manor] Skabiosa's Gazebo

- How to Obtain: Craft at a Furniture Workshop

5127.name: Loopy Tree Forest Pillars
5127.description:
Pillars imbued with the serene darkness and orderly energy of the Loopy Tree Forest. Some say that they can hear the sounds of the forest when they lean against these pillars at night.

- Usage: Craft [Manor] Skabiosa's Gazebo

- How to Obtain: Craft at a Furniture Workshop

5128.name: Okiara Ripple Effect Floor
5128.description:
This item was created by Skabiosa, the work supervisor of Kamasylvia, who was inspired by the currents slowly flowing on the bed of the Okiara River leading to the origins of Okiara River, on his way for relaxation at Lake Flondor. It is used as a part of Skabiosa's Gazebo.

- Usage: Craft [Manor] Skabiosa's Gazebo

- How to Obtain: Craft at a Furniture Workshop

5139.name: Grándiha Style Outdoor Stone Base
5139.description:
An outdoor stone base crafted in the Grándiha style where only the Ganelle princesses and Vedir princesses were allowed to enter long ago. The flawlessly symmetrical exterior is said to reflect the perfect balance between the Ganelle and Vedir during that time.

- Usage: Craft [Manor] Flondor Pond

- How to Obtain: Craft at a Furniture Workshop

5140.name: Miloberry's Apu Apu Waterstarwort
5140.description:
Mystical leaves that multiply in large amounts with an apu apu when plunked in the water with a plop! Miloberry, a fruit seller in Lake Flondor, found out about it when he eavesdropped on the alchemists. You might be able to craft it with the knowledge of Miloberry's Apu Apu Waterstarwort.

- Usage: Craft [Manor] Flondor Pond

- How to Obtain: Perform Alchemy in your residence with the following ingredients

- Ingredients:
 Dead Tree Essence x1
 Fairy Powder x10
 Essence of Liquor x10
 Spirit's Leaf x10

5141.name: Vilentia's Vedelona Bouquet
5141.description:
A bouquet of Vedelona made personally by Vilentia, the seed vendor in Grána. She is extremely proud of her work and claims that this alone is the biggest factor in raising the value of the manor to a higher standard.

- Usage: Craft the following [Manor] furniture
 [Manor] Flondor Pond
 [Manor] Stella's Hope Ornament
 [Manor] Morning Mist's Embrace

- How to Obtain: Complete [Manor] recurring quest via the seed vendor Vilentia in Grána

5142.name: Lion's Gaze
5142.description:
A decorative piece for the Lion's Reach Fountain. Each of the four lion heads face a different direction. The words "Be always vigilant like a lion" are lightly engraved below the piece. It went out of production after Serendia was conquered by Calpheon and none of them remain in Serendia. The Calpheon merchants are suspected to have taken all of them when Calpheon conquered Serendia.

- Usage: Craft [Manor] Lion's Reach Fountain

- How to Obtain: Complete the [Manor] Lion's Gaze via the jeweler Bianstimi in Calpheon and exchange with Moonlight Opal x10

5143.name: Northern Heidel Gothic Fountain
5143.description:
A gothic fountain produced in Northern Heidel before Serendia came under Calpheon's rule. It is no longer produced, but Jemkas Wyrmsbane has the remaining stock of it.

- Usage: Craft [Manor] Lion's Reach Fountain

- How to Obtain: Complete the [Manor] Northern Heidel Gothic Fountain quest via Jemkas Wyrmsbane in Heidel, then talk to him with 30 Energy

5145.name: Pedestal of Honor
5145.description:
A Pedestal of Honor where the Pinnacle of Honor Trophy can be placed. The Old Moon Guild created it first and released the design so that any adventurer can make it. Yan, the leader of the Old Moon Guild, said the following as the design was being released to the world, "Let's work towards reaching the pinnacle of all that we do so that one day, we can place the trophy of honor upon the pedestal."

- Usage: Craft [Manor] Life Guru Trophy
Arrange Pinnacle of Honor and Pedestal of Honor into a [I] shape to combine them.

- How to Obtain: Craft at a Furniture Workshop

5147.name: Angel's Pedestal
5147.description:
A pedestal made by the Heidel Villagers while thinking of Lara. The Laurus Nobilis Nest can be placed on top of it. It was initially planned by Lebyos, the Heidel Furniture Dealer, and named it Angel's Pedestal.

- Usage: Craft [Manor] Laurus Nobilis Trophy
Arrange Laurus Nobilis Nest and Angel's Pedestal into a [I] shape to combine them.

- How to Obtain: Craft at a Furniture Workshop

5148.name: Vase of Florin's Hope
5148.description:
A flower vase crafted by Izella of Florin for adventurers who shared the pain of her son, Stella. She says that she is not very skillful, but the vase has been appraised as one of intricate and elegant craftsmanship.

- Usage: Craft [Manor] Stella's Hope Ornament

- How to Obtain: Complete [Manor] daily quest via Izella in Florin

5149.name: Indomitable Lion of Serendia
5149.description:
An Indomitable Lion discovered by the Ahib Lejenti in the Hadum-infested Serendia territory. The king of Serendia gave this only to the greatest heroes of the past who took the most active role in saving the nation from a great crisis.

- Usage: Craft [Manor] Glory of Heidel

- How to Obtain: Complete [Manor] daily quest via Lejenti in Elvia Glish

5150.name: Pedestal of the People's Throne
5150.description:
A pedestal on which you can place the Indomitable Lion statue given only to great heroes of the past in Serendia. A pedestal crafted by the royalty, destroyed when Calpheon took over, so the crafting method is the only thing left of it.

- Usage: Craft [Manor] Glory of Heidel

- How to Obtain: Craft at a Furniture Workshop

5154.name: Sheltering Roof
5154.description:
A roof made of properly faced stones. It was made from a combination of many materials to provide a shelter under the shade and stay cool from the scorching mid-day heat. Usually used for outdoor sheds.

- Usage: Craft [Manor] Stonetail Outdoor Shed

- How to Obtain: Craft at a Furniture Workshop

5155.name: Clip-clop Stonetail Mobile
5155.description:
A mobile that clip-clops in the wind handmade by Gula and Shamhain of the Stonetail Horse Club. A mobile suitable for the Stonetail Outdoor Shed that you can place in the manor.

- Usage: Craft [Manor] Stonetail Outdoor Shed

- How to Obtain: Complete [Manor] daily quest via Shamhain at Stonetail Horse Ranch

5156.name: Sturdy Stone Floor
5156.description:
Floor made from Sturdy Snow White Stone. Many materials were combined to add the finishing touch so that it doesn't absorb all the blazing heat coming from the sun outdoors. It's usually used for crafting flooring for outdoor sheds.

- Usage: Craft [Manor] Stonetail Outdoor Shed

- How to Obtain: Craft at a Furniture Workshop

5161.name: Hero's Small Lamp
5161.description:
A hero's small lamp crafted at the Crow's Nest. It gives off a gentler light than the Alchemist's Small Lamp. It was named after the heroes who battled at the Pit of the Undying.

- Usage: Craft [Manor] Dim Runn Lamp

- How to Obtain: Exchange with Crow Coin x100 at Crow Coin Shop

5162.name: Tidal Blue Lamp Post
5162.description:
An Tidal Blue lamp posted crafted at Crow's Nest. It gives off gentler light than the lamp post crafted by the Shakatu Merchants. The Shakatu Merchants are suspected to have crafted this lamp post variation earlier than the Crows, but the Crows have remained silent on that matter.

- Usage: Craft [Manor] Dim Runn Lamp

- How to Obtain: Exchange with Crow Coin x500 at Crow Coin Shop

5163.name: Fine Rectangular Thuja Water Frame Base
5163.description:
A rectangular frame base for containing water made of finely processed Thuja Plywood. Unlike the frame bases made from ordinary plywood, it maintains the temperature of hot water for a long time. It was made by combining a variety of materials so that the wood wouldn't rot.

- Usage: Craft [Manor] Morning Mist's Embrace

- How to Obtain: Craft at a Furniture Workshop

5164.name: Jar of Dawn's Mist
5164.description:
A jar containing the mist of dawn that calms down your nerves and relaxes your mind. Your troubles and worries all vanish from your mind when you are surrounded by the mist.

- Usage: Craft [Manor] Morning Mist's Embrace

- How to Obtain: Purchase from the node manager Pataro in Morning Fog Post

5165.name: Bath of Origins
5165.description:
Duvencrue's finest hot spring water, Dragon's Tears, corrodes ordinary stone material, but the Bath of Origins was crafted strong enough to contain Dragon's Tears.

- Usage: Craft [Manor] Morning Mist's Embrace

- How to Obtain: Craft at a Furniture Workshop

5167.name: Beeswax
5167.description:
Beeswax that you can craft by Heating Wild Beehives. It can be used to craft different types of candles.

- Usage #1: Craft Delotia-scented Candle

- Usage #2: Craft the following [Manor] furniture
 Jade Starlight Candle Stand
 Jade Starlight Wall Candle Stand

- How to Obtain: Processing (Manufacture) - Heating with the following materials

- Materials:
 Wild Beehive x30

5168.name: Delotia-scented Candle
5168.description:
A candle crafted by Heating Special Delotias and Beeswax together. This candle has recently become very popular as the subtle yet deep scent of Delotia soothes the mind.

- Usage: Craft the following [Manor] furniture
 [Manor] Starspun Chandelier
 [Manor] Sunflare Chandelier
 [Manor] Aal's Sanctuary Wall Candle Stand

- How to Obtain: Purchase from the ceramics vendor Tama Nana in O'dyllita or Processing (Manufacture) - Heating with the following materials

- Materials:
 Beeswax x10
 Special Delotia x10
 Knitting Yarn x1

5169.name: Sturdy Snow White Stone
5169.description:
Sturdy snow white stone material finely processed and made from the combination of well-refined stone and many materials usually used for outdoor structures. Structures made from the Sturdy Snow White Stone don't get too heated mid-summer like those made of ordinary stone material and do not split in mid-winter. The high-quality material is perfect for outdoor structures that are greatly influenced by the weather since they are so durable even heavy rain won't corrode them.

- Usage: Craft [Manor] furniture

- How to Obtain: Processing (Manufacture) - Grinding with the following materials

- Materials:
 Polished Stone x10
 Pure Powder Reagent x10
 Purified Water x10
 Black Stone Powder x10
 Clown's/Legendary Beast's/Sinner's/Tyrant's/Wise Man's Blood x1

5170.name: Design: Starspun Chandelier
5170.description:
A design discovered from the records of the Ancient Kingdom of Orzeca. Amarin, the Luxury Vendor, worked to restore it, and it's used for crafting a Starspun Chandelier. Amarin sells it only to those chosen by the Queen of O'dyllita, Viorencia Odore.

- Usage: Craft [Manor] Starspun Chandelier

- How to Obtain: Purchase from the luxury vendor Amarin in O'dyllita

5171.name: Design: Sunflare Chandelier
5171.description:
A design discovered from the records of the Ancient Kingdom of Orzeca. Amarin, the Luxury Vendor, worked to restore it, and it's used for crafting Sunflare Chandelier. Amarin sells it only to those chosen by the Queen of O'dyllita, Viorencia Odore.

- Usage: Craft [Manor] Sunflare Chandelier

- How to Obtain: Purchase from the luxury vendor Amarin in O'dyllita

5173.name: Design: Olvian Bookshelf
5173.description:
A design for the Olvian Bookshelf crafted by Wocester, the Furniture Dealer in Olvia. He says that he crafted it, thinking of Olvia, a friendly, timeless town. It is one of the few pieces of furniture crafted by him that is not sold at his furniture shop.

- Usage: Craft [Manor] Olvian Bookshelf

- How to Obtain: Exchange Energy-exuding Hide x1 with Wocester in Olvia

 ※ Energy-exuding Hide can be obtained by taking down rare hunting monsters.

5174.name: Design: Olvian Sofa
5174.description:
A design for the Olvian Sofa crafted by Wocester, the Furniture Dealer in Olvia. He says that he crafted it, thinking of Olvia, a friendly, timeless town. It is one of the few pieces of furniture crafted by him that is not sold at his furniture shop.

- Usage: Craft [Manor] Olvian Sofa

- How to Obtain: Exchange Energy-exuding Hide x1 with Wocester in Olvia

 ※ Energy-exuding Hide can be obtained by taking down rare hunting monsters.

5176.name: Design: Olvian Wardrobe
5176.description:
A design for the Olvian Wardrobe crafted by Wocester, the Furniture Dealer in Olvia. He says that he crafted it, thinking of Olvia, a friendly, timeless town. It is one of the few pieces of furniture crafted by him that is not sold at his furniture shop.

- Usage: Craft [Manor] Olvian Wardrobe

- How to Obtain: Exchange Energy-exuding Hide x1 with Wocester in Olvia

 ※ Energy-exuding Hide can be obtained by taking down rare hunting monsters.

5179.name: Design: Olvian Bed
5179.description:
A design for the Olvian Bed crafted by Wocester, the Furniture Dealer in Olvia. He says that he crafted it, thinking of Olvia, a friendly, timeless town. It is one of the few pieces of furniture crafted by him that is not sold at his furniture shop.

- Usage: Craft [Manor] Olvian Bed

- How to Obtain: Exchange Energy-exuding Hide x1 with Wocester in Olvia

 ※ Energy-exuding Hide can be obtained by taking down rare hunting monsters.

5184.name: Bonfire of Dreams
5184.description:
A bonfire that lasts a long time with the power of Hesed's Crystal. Though it generates heat for a long time, it maintains a warm and cozy temperature perhaps due to the power of Hesed's Crystal.

- Usage: Craft [Manor] Herald of Dawn Fireplace

- How to Obtain: Processing (Manufacture) - Simple Alchemy with the following ingredients

- Ingredients:
 Bonfire Tool x1
 Hesed's Crystal x5
 Black Gem Fragment x100
 Oil of Corruption x30

5186.name: An Anthology of the Ancient Kingdom
5186.description:
A collection of stories about the Ancient Kingdom of Orzeca, which wrought its own ruin. It contains the everyday stories of the Orzecans, their culture, and their hopes, but some parts of the text are written in an undecipherable Ancient language that is not the Orzecan language.

- Usage: Craft [Manor] Handcrafted Ancient Kingdom Bookshelf

- How to Obtain: Complete [Manor] quest via Denulo in Crypt of Resting Thoughts

5194.name: Design: Crown of Honor
5194.description:
A design you can use to craft a Crown of Honor. Eil, who runs the Elionism chapel in Heidel, only shares it with those who have proved their special affection for Serendia.

- Usage: Craft Crown of Honor

- How to Obtain: Craft at a Furniture Workshop

5196.name: Design: Flondor Breeze Ceiling
5196.description:
A design you can use to craft a Flondor Breeze Ceiling. This item was created by Skabiosa, who was inspired by the light breeze along Lake Flondor.

- Usage: Craft [Manor] Flondor Breeze Ceiling

- How to Obtain: Complete the [Manor] Skabiosa's Gazebo via Skabiosa in Grána and exchange with Peridot Petal x15

5197.name: Design: Okiara Ripple Effect Floor
5197.description:
A design you can use to craft a Okiara Ripple-Patterned Floor. This item was created by Skabiosa, who was inspired by the currents slowly flowing on the bed of the Okiara River.

- Usage: Craft [Manor] Flondor Breeze Ceiling

- How to Obtain: Complete the [Manor] Skabiosa's Gazebo via Skabiosa in Grána and exchange with Peridot Petal x15

5198.name: Dragon's Tears
5198.description:
Hot spring water called Dragon's Tears that works the best for relieving weariness. It's not actual dragon's tears but was made from similar ingredients. It can be brewed via alchemy when you have the knowledge of Dragon's Tear.

- Usage: Craft [Manor] Morning Mist's Embrace

- How to Obtain: Perform Alchemy in your residence with the following ingredients

- Ingredients:
 Distilled Water x50
 Clear Liquid Reagent x50
 Everlasting Herb x50
 Trace of Nature x50
 Magical Shard x4

5199.name: Keplan Horned Cocoon Silk
5199.description:
It is thought to be extinct by most, but one adventurer reportedly saw it sleeping inside a radiant flower in the Rhua Tree Stub. Legends say it remains curled up, seemingly dead as a fossil, but the smell of a clod of fertile soil wakes it up. Perhaps if you go to Merv, the Calpheon tailor, you might be able to extract silk from the Keplan Horned Cocoon.

- Usage: Craft [Manor] Carpet of a Forgotten King

- How to Obtain: Exchange the Keplan Horn Cocoon with the tailor Merv in Calpheon.

 ※ Keplan Horn Cocoon can be obtained by bringing Fertile Oil-Rich Soil to Rhua Tree Stub and completing [Manor] daily quest.

5205.name: Fruit of Nature
5205.description:
An ingredient used in Alchemy that can be obtained through farming. It can be used directly or refined into an essence for use.

- How to Obtain: Farming (in a garden, rarely)

5206.name: Essence of Nature
5206.description:
An essence extracted from Fruit of Nature, a fruit obtained at a low rate through Farming. It's used as an ingredient in Alchemy.

- How to Obtain: Craft via an Alchemy Tool in your residence when at least Alchemy Apprentice 1.

- Crafting Materials:
Fruit of Nature x2
Maple Sap x4
Trace of Nature x2
Fortune Teller Mushroom x3

5301.name: Clear Liquid Reagent
5301.description:
A catalyst that can be applied to various Alchemy mixtures.

- Usage: Craft Alchemy materials & elixirs

- How to Obtain: Crafted via an Alchemy Tool in your residence if at least Alchemy Beginner 1

- Ingredients:
Salt x1
Sunrise Herb x1
Purified Water x1
Wild Grass x1 or Weeds x1

5302.name: Pure Powder Reagent
5302.description:
A catalyst that can be applied to various Alchemy mixtures.

- Usage: Craft various Alchemy materials & elixirs

- How to Obtain: Crafted via an Alchemy Tool in your residence if at least Alchemy Beginner 1

- Ingredients:
Sugar x1
Silver Azalea x1
Purified Water x1
Wild Grass x1 or Weeds x1

5303.name: Tenacious Origin of Life
5303.description:
Essence of life obtained from wild grass and flowers.
It can withstand high pressure and heat.

- Usage: Craft Flawless Spirit Stone via an Alchemy Tool in your residence
(Refer to the Crafting Notes for more details.)

- How to Obtain: Craft via an Alchemy Tool in your residence if at least Alchemy Skilled 1.

- Materials #1:
Sunrise Herb x50
Silver Azalea x50
Fire Flake Flower x50
Dry Mane Grass x50
Silk Honey Grass x50

- Materials #2:
High-quality Sunrise Herb x17
High-quality Silver Azalea x17
High-quality Fire Flake Flower x17
High-quality Dry Mane Grass x17
High-quality Silk Honey Grass x17

- Materials #3:
Special Sunrise Herb x8
Special Silver Azalea x8
Special Fire Flake Flower x8
Special Dry Mane Grass x8
Special Silk Honey Grass x8

5304.name: Rough Opulent Crystal
5304.description:
An opulent crystal obtained by combining various crystals using Alchemy.
It has an unusual appearance and can be easily infused with various energies.

- Usage: Craft Flawless Spirit Stone via an Alchemy Tool in your residence
(Refer to the Crafting Notes for more details.)

- How to Obtain: Craft via an Alchemy Tool in your residence if at least Alchemy Skilled 1

- Materials:
Translucent Crystal x50
Mud Crystal x50
Black Crystal x50
Blue Crystal x50
Violet Crystal x50

5305.name: Flawless Spirit Stone
5305.description:
A stone imbued with the energy of life using Alchemy, as if a spirit itself dwells within.
Its properties may shift and change, depending on the type of energy bestowed upon it.

- Usage #1: Craft Destruction Spirit Stone of at least Sharp grade via an Alchemy Tool in your residence

- Usage #2: Craft Guardian Spirit Stone of at least Sharp grade via an Alchemy Tool in your residence
(Refer to the Crafting Notes for more details.)

- How to Obtain: Craft via an Alchemy Tool in your residence if at least Alchemy Skilled 1

- Materials:
Oil of Tranquility x10
Tenacious Origin of Life x4
Rough Opulent Crystal x4

5306.name: Reagent of Harmonious Spirits
5306.description:
A reagent that encourages the harmonious mixing of different energies.
Only Alustin knows the formula to make this reagent.

- Usage #1: Craft Destruction Spirit Stone of at least Sharp grade via an Alchemy Tool in your residence

- Crafting Materials:
Reagent of Harmonious Spirits x1
Cron Stone x5
Flawless Spirit Stone x5
Metal Solvent x50
Mystical Spirit Powder x50

- Usage #2: Craft Guardian Spirit Stone of at least Sharp grade via an Alchemy Tool in your residence

- Crafting Materials:
Reagent of Harmonious Spirits x1
Cron Stone x5
Flawless Spirit Stone x5
Gem Polisher x50
Mystical Spirit Powder x50

- How to Obtain: Weekly quest rewards from Alustin in Velia if at least Alchemy Master 10 or Alchemy Mastery 800

5401.description:

5807.name: Ruddy Manganese Nodule
5807.description:
A rare mineral that exists in the bottom of the ocean. The old sediments permeated with coralline algae shine brilliantly. It is hard enough to be used as building material, but it is as beautiful as a gem.

- Usage: Craft Black Dragon Figurehead, Stratus Wind Sail

Can be crafted at the Ship Part Workshop in Port Epheria 1-4, 2F. A Black Dragon Figurehead and Stratus Wind Sail must be crafted and enhanced in order to upgrade an Epheria Carrack.

- How to Obtain:
Purchase for 200 Crow Coins at the Crow Coin Shop
Reward from [Weekly] For the Young Otter Merchants
Selectable reward from [Weekly] Old Moon Guild's Candidum Hunter

Processing (Manufacture) - Use Drying on the item to obtain Moon Vein Flax Fabric x10.

- How to Obtain:

Barter with [Level 5] Sea Trade Goods

5867.name: Fundamentals of Cooking
5867.description:
A book containing all of the secret recipes of the legendary Kamasylvian chef, Baermalo Hona. It includes information on everything you need to know to become a great cook: timeless recipes; how to use the five senses to bring life to food; what clothes and tools a chef must have to make cooking beautiful; how to keep the right attitude towards cooking that will make your day more enjoyable.

5868.name: Professional's Satisfying Dinner Meal
5868.description:

- Talk to Heidel's stable keeper Izaro, Calpheon's skill instructor Valks, Altinova's cook Edman, or Grána's cook Heidi to exchange this item for Fundamentals of Cooking x1.

- Usage: Craft Kzarka Statue

- Materials:
Kzarka's Bloodstone x3
Blood Ruby x50
Fire Horn x100
Concentrated Boss's Aura x1
Trace of Nature x500

- How to Obtain: Defeat Kzarka (very low chance to obtain)

6358.description:

- Materials:
Karanda's Talon x3

Swaying Wind Shard x100
Concentrated Boss's Aura x1

6393.name: Elkarr
6393.description:
This crystal has the power to awaken the sleeping weapon at Kratuga Ancient Ruins. Magical energy can be used to draw out the dormant power within.
You can use Simple Alchemy to combine Elkarr x1, Black Magic Crystal - Precision x1, Forest Fury x2, and Magical Shard x10 to obtain Crystal of Elkarr.

6394.name: Chowder
6394.description:
Chowder made with clams and pork, seasoned with black pepper. It's considered soul food for sailors and is commonly eaten with bread which you dip in the chowder.

- Effect:
 Recover 100 Sailor Condition

- How to Obtain: Craft via a Cooking Utensil in your residence if at least Cooking Professional 1.

- Ingredients:
Dried Shellfish x5 OR Dried Pearl Oyster Flesh x1
Pepper x2
Pork x2
Milk x1
Teff Bread x1

6395.name: Elixir of Regeneration
6395.description:
An elixir made by Alustin after years of research in order to cure the sailors who have been out at sea. Sailors who drink this elixir are cured to full condition within min.

- Usage: Treat sick sailors
- Talk to any Wharf Manager and open the sailor management window to recover your sailors.

- Effects:
Cures one sailor
Recovers condition to 100%

- How to Obtain: Processing (Manufacture) - Simple Alchemy

- Ingredients:
Mandragora Essence x1
Essence of Nature x1
Oil of Regeneration x1
Troll Blood x2
Grape x4

6397.name: Mandragora Essence
6397.description:
Essence made of Mandragora poison extracted from its roots which resemble a human figure. Although it is poison, it may serve as medicine when used in small amounts. It is rare because only a limited amount can be extracted from each Mandragora.

- Usage: Craft Elixir of Regeneration

- Ingredients:
Mandragora Essence x1
Essence of Nature x1
Oil of Regeneration x1
Troll Blood x2
Grape x4

- How to Obtain: Exchange with Crow Coin x100 via the Crow Coin Shop

6399.name: Ah'krad
6399.description:
A crystal of depravity filled with the mighty power of the Ahib. Magical energy can be used to draw out the dormant power within.
Use Simple Alchemy in the Processing window to combine Ah'krad x1, Black Magic Crystal - Precision x1, and Magical Shard x20 into an Ah'krad Crystal.

6400.name: Olucas
6400.description:
A crystal that serves as the power sources to awaken slumbering Boulder Golems. Magical energy can be used to draw out the dormant power within.
Use Simple Alchemy in the Processing window to turn Olucas x1, Black Magic Crystal - Precision x1, and Magical Shard x20 into Olucas' Crystal.

6451.name: Ocean Horizon Key
6451.description:
The only key to the sunken chest containing the Heaven's Tower. One day, a child in Oquilla's Eye dreamed of a whale swimming slowly towards a gap that seemed to be the ocean's edge. When he awoke, the child created the first thing that came to mind, and some say that thing is the Ocean Horizon Key.

- Usage: Interact with a Dimly Shimmering Treasure Chest hidden in Oquilla's Eye

- How to Obtain: Processing (Manufacture) - Heating with the following materials

- Materials:
 Black Gold Ingot x10
 Tear of the Ocean x10
 Blue Whale Oil x1

6656.name: Purified Water
6656.description:
Clean water that has had impurities filtered out of it.

- Usage #1: Right-click to quench Thirst
- Effect: Cures Heatstroke
- Duration: Instant
- Cooldown: 5 sec

- Usage #2: Pouring on a Garden
- Effect: Increases Garden available Water Deposit

- How to Obtain #1: In the Processing window use (Manufacture) - Filtering on
 x1 Processing: Bottle of River Water
 x5 Processing: Cactus Sap, Bag of Muddy Water

- How to Obtain #2: Purchase from a General Goods Vendor in
 Sand Grain Bazaar, Muiquun, Arehaza

6657.name: Bag of Muddy Water
6657.description:
Water collected from desert using a shovel. It can be filtered to make Purified Water.

- How to Obtain: Use Shabby Shovel in the desert to obtain a bag of muddy water.

※ Pouring a Bag of Muddy Water on a Garden will increase the available Water Deposit.

8179.name: Sunset Glow Crystal
8179.description:
A crystal wrapped in the magical energies of Caphras Stones. It appears to be usable to awaken the special potential of an artina sol.
 After much dedicated research, a new method was discovered to awaken the artina sol.

- Usage #1: Upgrade Artina Sol

- Usage #2: Obtain Caphras Stone x10,000

※ Additional Effect: Extra AP Against Monsters +35
※ You can upgrade items by summoning the Black Spirit.
※ You will have a 100% chance of successfully reforming an item.
※ You can upgrade the following:

Fiery Artina Sol > Fiery Sunset Artina Sol
Storm Devoured Artina Sol > Storm Devoured Sunset Artina Sol
※ Right-click to start item reform.

Regarding why only Vaha's earring can be found in the other biomes and not the respective architect's personal belongings, archaeologists have developed a theory that this is all due to the "Hidden Influence" of Vaha who oversaw the entire stronghold.

※ Requirement:
Cooking Box: Obtain Carolin's Expert Packaging Skills (Cooking) Knowledge
At least Processing Artisan 1

- Common Fish
- Capture Method: Normal Fishing

- Usage: Fried Fish, Steamed Fish, Fish Soup, etc.

 ※ You can sell the fish you caught to Trade Managers located in major towns and cities.

8396.name: Erebjork's Grudge
8396.description:
This pure white stone is considered to be a rare find as they're usually only discovered in places around the Mountain of eternal Winter that Erebjork has visited. The natives of Everfrost claim these stones to be the physical manifestation of Erebjork's grudge.

- Usage: Craft Breath of Omua

- Crafting Method: Processing (Manufacture) - Heating

- Crafting Materials:
Erebjork's Grudge x30

- How to Obtain: Hunting quests in Mountain of Eternal Winter

8397.name: Design: Calpheon Noble Dress - Drakania
8397.description:

- How to Obtain: Purchase from NPC Merv's Amity Shop in Calpheon City.

8411.name: Crystallized Despair
8411.description:
A stone that fell out of a Rift of Despair when shadowy beings corrupted by power of Hadum attempted to force their way into the rift. It is commonly referred to as "Crystallized Despair."

- Crafting Method: Processing (Manufacture) - Heating

- Usage #1: Craft Blessed Soul Fragment
(Enhance alchemy stone defensive stats)

- Crafting Materials
Forest Fury x10
Magical Shard x50
Black Stone x100
Crystallized Despair x200

- Usage #2: Craft Exalted Soul Fragment
(Enhance blessed alchemy stone defensive stats)

- Crafting Materials
Forest Fury x5
Magical Shard x25
Alchemy Stone Shard x50
Crystallized Despair x100

- Usage #3: Exchange with Hyunyong
Crystallized Despair x1: Embers of Hongik x2

- Usage #4: Exchange a set amount to increase your Enhancement Chance in the Enhancement window

- Enhancement Chance Increase: +50 to +100

- How to Obtain: Defeat the monsters in Elvia Calpheon

8417.name: Cup of Earth's Sorrows
8417.description:
A crystal fused with Shards of the Night and the Powder of Corruption, which were both created when the moon rose over the night sky of an Elvia Realm consumed by Hadum. It takes the form of sorrowful earth.

- Usage: Upgrade the following earrings
Deboreka Earring
Tungrad Earring
Narc Ear Accessory
Capotia Earring
Black Distortion Earring
Dawn Earring
Ethereal Earring
Vaha's Dawn

※ Additional reform effect: All AP +3
※ You can upgrade items by summoning the Black Spirit.
※ You will have a 100% chance of successfully reforming an item.
※ Right-click to start item reform.

- How to Obtain: Processing (Manufacture) - Heating with the following materials
Magical Shard x30
Shard of the Furious Night x50
Shard of the Tearful Night x50
Shard of the Drained Night x100
Black Stone x100

※ Cup of Earth's Sorrows x1 will be consumed per item reform attempt. The reformed Arboreal earring will gain an additional effect.
※ Arboreal earrings cannot be reformed any further.
※ Visit a blacksmith and use the Refined Essence of Emotions to extract the Cup of Earth's Sorrows from an Arboreal accessory, retaining both the cup and unreformed accessory.
※ Lejenti, in the underground chamber of Glish, can also cleanse Arboreal accessories, removing their reformed state and destroying the cup.

8421.name: Blessed Soul Fragment
8421.description:
A soul fragment forged from the desires to protect all of existence from the two scorching suns. Using the Blessed Soul Fragment can draw out the inner potential of an alchemy stone through its power fueled by desire.

- Usage: Upgrade the following alchemy stones of yellow-grade and higher
Sharp Alchemy Stone of Destruction
Resplendent Alchemy Stone of Destruction
Splendid Alchemy Stone of Destruction
Shining Alchemy Stone of Destruction
Vell's Heart
Khan's Heart: Destruction
Ator's Power Stone
Sharp Alchemy Stone of Protection
Resplendent Alchemy Stone of Protection
Splendid Alchemy Stone of Protection
Shining Alchemy Stone of Protection
Perilla's Star
Khan's Heart: Protection

※ Additional Effects:
All Damage Reduction +2
Monster Damage Reduction Rate +1%
All Resistance +2%

※ You will have a 100% chance of successfully reforming an alchemy stone.
※ Right-click to start alchemy stone reform.

- How to Obtain: Processing (Manufacture) - Heating with the following materials
Forest Fury x10
Magical Shard x50
Black Stone x100
Crystallized Despair x200

※ Blessed Soul Fragment x1 will be consumed per reform attempt and apply the additional effects.

8427.name: Corrupted Breath
8427.description:
The breath exhaled from beings corrupted by the Elvia Realm. It has a low chance of being obtained from defeating monsters. Perform Simple Alchemy on it with Frenzy Draught to add the Extra AP Against Monsters +5 effect.

- Usage #1: Craft Frenzy Draught of Corruption

- Crafting Method: Processing (Manufacture) - Simple Alchemy

- Ingredients:
Frenzy Draught x1
Corrupted Breath x1

- Usage #2: Craft [Event] Magical: Frenzy Draught of Corruption

- Ingredients:
[Event] Magical: Frenzy Draught x1
Corrupted Breath x2

※ You can Mass Process with 10x the usual amount of materials and 1 Ibellab's Essence per batch.

- How to Obtain: Defeat monsters in Elvia Calpheon

8431.name: Balenos Mullet
8431.description:
A mullet caught only in the waterfalls, seas, and fresh waters of the Balenos territory. Known for its delicious taste, it fetches a better price than average mullets.
An ingredient that can be obtained through Fishing. You can either sell it to Trade Managers or use it for Cooking.
- Common fish
- Capture Method: Normal Fishing

- Usage: Fried Fish, Steamed Fish, Fish Soup, etc.

※ You can sell the fish you caught to Trade Managers located in major towns and cities.

8432.name: Exalted Soul Fragment
8432.description:
A soul fragment forged from the desires to protect all of existence from the two scorching suns. Using the Exalted Soul Fragment can further draw out the inner potential of an alchemy stone through its power fueled by desire.

- Usage: Upgrade the following Blessed alchemy stones
Blessed Sharp Alchemy Stone of Destruction
Blessed Resplendent Alchemy Stone of Destruction
Blessed Splendid Alchemy Stone of Destruction
Blessed Shining Alchemy Stone of Destruction
Blessed Vell's Heart
Blessed Khan's Heart: Destruction
Blessed Ator's Power Stone
Blessed Sharp Alchemy Stone of Protection
Blessed Resplendent Alchemy Stone of Protection
Blessed Splendid Alchemy Stone of Protection
Blessed Shining Alchemy Stone of Protection
Blessed Perilla's Star
Blessed Khan's Heart: Protection

※ Additional Effect:
All Damage Reduction +2

※ You will have a 100% chance of successfully reforming an alchemy stone.
※ Right-click to start alchemy stone reform.

- How to Obtain: Processing (Manufacture) - Heating with the following materials
Forest Fury x5
Magical Shard x25
Alchemy Stone Shard x50
Crystallized Despair x100

※ Exalted Soul Fragment x1 will be consumed per reform attempt and apply an additional effect.

Magical Shard x20
Memory Fragment x50
Concentrated Boss Crystal x60

This crystal bears the power to upgrade gear to its fullest potential, a power that is maintained day and night thanks to the ultra processing techniques of the Old Moon Guild.

This crystal is currently used to craft Resplendent Weapon Reform Stones which can upgrade special gear forged by the Old Moon Guild to its fullest potential.

- How to Obtain: Quest reward for completing Jetina's "Resplendent Weapon Reform Stone: Oquilla Sky Crystal"

11648.name: Capotia Necklace
11648.description:
A necklace that the Secret Guards found. It is decorated with the Crystal of Symmetry, an ancient treasure. It exudes powerful energy.

It can be enhanced with the same item, but due to the Crystal of Symmetry, the item will not be destroyed if enhancement fails. However, the enhancement level will drop and the Max Durability will decrease by 10.

- Ingredient for Max Durability Repair: Yona's Fragment

<How to obtain Capotia Accessories>
Ring: Reach Lv. 58
Earring: Reach Lv. 59
Belt: Reach Lv. 60
Necklace: Reach Lv. 61
After reaching Lv. 61, you can craft a Capotia Necklace by processing Yona's Fragment x400, Latent Boss Aura x3, and Oil of Storms x5 with Manufacture.

※ You can accept the quest from <Old Moon Manager> Jetina once per day to exchange a PEN (V) Capotia Accessory for a different Capotia Accessory of the same tier.

11697.name: Kharazad Necklace
11697.description:
The royal accessory of Kharazad, son of Ahmad and founder of the Aksulp dynasty.

Kharazad, in his unwavering faith, faced the trials set by Aal, the divine, to obtain the "endlessly blazing flame". With it, he reforged the very soul of his cherished wife, Hadiya, daughter of Rashid.

With this power, he vanquished the evil god, breathed life into the tribes of the wilderness, and ascended as the first sovereign of ancient Mediah.

"O Hadiya, as your radiant gaze dimmed, my heart was cast into eternal shadow."

※ Accessory crystal socket gained when equipped.

16433.description:

16479.name: Manos Hoe
16479.description:
A modified hoe infused with Manos Stone that can absorb resources. This hoe can be used to gather Lakiaros. It increases Gathering Mastery.
- How to use: Interact (interaction key) with gatherable plants.

- This item can be repaired.
- It can be enhanced with Black Stone and Concentrated Magical Black Stone.

After enhancement, some of the following functions may improve when you dig up Lakiaros.
Dig Deeply
- Dig up more dirt while avoiding pebbles and the Lakiaro.
- If the hoe directly lands on the Lakiaro, its value will be decreased but not as much.
Dig Shallowly
- The value of the Lakiaro will not decrease.
- Dirt and pebbles cannot be dug up.
- The number of shallow digs available will increase as enhancement level increases.

※ Depending on your Gathering Mastery, your gathering item drop rate and quantity will increase.
※ Go to My Information > Life Skill tab to read more about Gathering Mastery.

- Usage: Residence or Manor decor
