24133.name: Red Sheep Hide Cushion
24133.description:
A high-quality cushion filled with cotton wool inside made of red nappa leather. It is decorated with golden buttons and tassels.

- Usage: Residence or Manor decor

- How to Obtain: Craft at a Furniture Workshop

24134.name: Blue Sheep Hide Cushion
24134.description:
A high-quality cushion made of blue patterned nappa leather. Patterns on sheepskin will eventually fade.

- Usage: Residence or Manor decor

- How to Obtain: Craft at a Furniture Workshop

24193.name: Doll
24193.description:
A small doll made of cotton fabric, silk, and animal fur. Noble children cannot live without it.

- Usage: Residence or Manor decor

- How to Obtain: Craft at a Furniture Workshop

24203.name: Round Pottery
24203.description: An old pottery made of mud. It is cracked everywhere.

24204.name: Quagmire Pottery
24204.description: A reddish pottery. It is decorated with jewels and platinum around the lid.

24205.name: Long Pottery
24205.description: A pottery made of mud. Some surfaces of it have come off because it was not glazed, but it might still does its job.

24206.name: Ruby Gourd Bottle
24206.description: A gourd-shaped bottle adorned with ruby. Seen as collectible by nobles, it is even exported overseas.

24207.name: Fancy Sapphire Vase
24207.description: A gourd-shaped bottle covered with sapphire. The unique sapphire-colored glaze is a proud specialty of the town of Glish.

24208.name: Emerald Gourd Bottle
24208.description: A gourd-shaped bottle covered with emerald. The unique emerald-colored glaze is a proud specialty of the town of Glish.

24209.name: Fancy Topaz Kettle
24209.description: A kettle adorned with topaz. It gives off a brilliant light when it catches sunlight.

24210.name: Beautiful Opal Vase
24210.description: A big opal pot. Various sizes of crystals create different colors and complicated patterns.

24211.name: Golden Hand Vase
24211.description: A golden gourd-shaped bottle. There is a constant stream of order for this bottle because people believe that gold brings fortune.

24212.name: Imperial Platinum Kettle
24212.description: An imperial platinum kettle with ruby lid. It is worth a lot because only professional metal workers can handle this level of ruby decoration.

24213.name: Ancient Artifact China
24213.description:
You can install this decoration in your residence.
Interacting with this article will give you a buff and consume its durability.
- Special Function: All Accuracy +12 for 1 hr upon use

24214.name: Ancient Artifact Pot
24214.description:
You can install this decoration in your residence.
Interacting with this article will give you a buff and consume its durability.
- Special Function: All Damage Reduction +8 for 1 hr upon use

24217.name: Loria's Hand Mirror
24217.description: Loria, also known as the mirror princess of Florin, never lets go of this mirror at home.

24218.name: Onion Pickle Jar
24218.description: A jar full of sweet and sour onion pickles.

24219.name: Olive Pickle Jar
24219.description: A jar full of fermented cucumber pickles.

24220.name: Green Herb Pot
24220.description: An herb pot from which Florin's own green herbs grow. Floriners believe this green herb brings fairies to their houses.

24221.name: Florin Dawn Wall Carpet
24221.description: A carpet made in Florin. The deep color really captures a moment of silent, chilly dawn.

24222.name: Florin Autumn Leaves Wall Carpet
24222.description: A carpet made in Florin. The feeling of taking a walk along an autumn path is expressed in elegant colors.

24223.name: Florin Sunset Wall Carpet
24223.description: A carpet depicting a stunning sunset in Florin. The pattern in the center really makes a statement.

24224.name: Tarif Gourd Bottle
24224.description: A gourd bottle made with Tarif's own style and technology.

24225.name: Tarif Pot
24225.description: A pot made with Tarif's own style and technology.

24226.name: Yisar Pjetyo Amulet
24226.description: An amulet frequently used by the alchemist Yisar Pjetyo. This one is supposed to greatly increase the success rate in alchemy.

24227.name: Allan Serbin Amulet
24227.description: An amulet frequently used by Allan Serbin. This one supposedly alleviates Allan's anxiety coming from being trapped inside a frame.

24228.name: Nantusa Letusa Amulet
24228.description: An amulet near Nantusa Letusa. This particular one is used to ward off evil spirits.

24229.name: Tarif White Cedar Jewelry Box
24229.description: This jewelry box is made with Tarif's own technology. Sturdy white cedar wood is used throughout, and the famous sculptor Zaramas Kasula took charge of the decoration.

24230.name: Tarif Blue Stone Jewelry Box
24230.description: This jewelry box is made with Tarif's own technology. The exotic blue stones are not spared in adorning this exquisite box.

24231.name: Desert Fogan Flower Pot
24231.description: A flower pot decorated in Valencia's Desert Fogan style.

24232.name: Desert Fogan Lamp
24232.description: A lamp decorated in Valencia's Desert Fogan style.

24233.name: Arehaza Semicircle Carpet
24233.description: A handcrafted semicircle carpet made in Arehaza. You can almost smell the town from this carpet.

24234.name: Arehaza Round Carpet
24234.description: A handcrafted round carpet made in Arehaza. The embroidery work is fine and delicate.

24235.name: Over the Rocky Mountain
24235.description: A seascape over the rocky mountain in eastern Valencia. The hyper-realistic expression will make your jaw drop.

24236.name: Arehaza Scenery
24236.description: A painting depicting Arehaza. Painted by an artist who was visiting Arehaza.

24237.name: Areha Palm Forest
24237.description: A landscape painting depicting Areha Palm Forest. The open-air feel of the scenery attracts buyers.

24242.name: Duvencrune Bronk Lamp
24242.description: A decorative lamp crafted through the unique craftsmanship of Duvencrune. The lamp is made from Thuja wood. The furniture artisan who originally designed the lamp named it the Bronk Lamp because the lamp closely resembled the facial features of Bronks.

24243.name: Duvencrune Crescent Lamp
24243.description: A decorative lamp crafted through the unique craftsmanship of Duvencrune. The lamp is made from Thuja wood. Its name comes from the crescent-like curves featured by the lamp.

24252.name: Oddly Patterned Flower Pot
24252.description: A flower pot with an odd pattern.

24255.name: Candle on a Pile of Books
24255.description: An item looking rather unsafe due to candles placed on top of piles of books.

24257.name: O'draxxia Candle Stand
24257.description: A candle stand with 4 candles to light up wide spaces such as a study or a living room. Made by mixing special ore and tin to prevent it from rusting easily, and can be found in many places in O'draxxia.

24259.name: Glamorous Patterned Pot
24259.description: A cheap pot with a fancy pattern that symbolizes wealth. Its large size is rumored to protect one's health, so it is purchased by many as a charm to keep in their homes.

24260.name: Blinding Opalescent Pot
24260.description: Seems to have a rather dull exterior, yet upon a close look, it emits a bright, opalescent light from within.

24261.name: Experimental Alchemy Tool
24261.description:
An experimental Alchemy tool used by the alchemists of O'draxxia. Not being mindful when using such tools can lead to great accidents.
Interacting with this item will give you a buff and consume its Durability.
- Special Function: All Accuracy +5 for 1 hr upon use

24262.name: Experimental Alchemy Tool Rack
24262.description: A tool rack to organize various alchemy tools used by the alchemists of O'draxxia.

24502.description:

- Usage: Residence or Manor decor

24535.name: Vatu's High-quality Dining Table
24535.description:
A high-quality dining table that Vatu, from the village of Eilton in the Mountain of Eternal Winter, cherishes.

- Usage: Residence or Manor decor

- How to Obtain: Craft at a Furniture Workshop

24536.name: [Manor] Balacs Triangular Outdoor Tent
24536.description:
A Balacs triangular outdoor tent that can only be crafted in Everfrost.

- Usage: Manor decor

24602.description:
A tapestry with a complicated pattern.

- Usage: Residence or Manor decor

- How to Obtain: Craft at a Furniture Workshop

24603.description:
A wool tapestry with a Mediahn pattern. Made by the residents of Ahto Farm.

- Usage: Residence or Manor decor

24634.description:

24661.name: O'draxxian Tapestry
24661.description: A tapestry made by master artisans of O'draxxia who utilized a whole variety of furs.

24662.name: Oddly Marked Tapestry
24662.description: A tapestry marked with a traditional symbol of O'draxxia.

24813.name: Multi-Patterned Carpet
24813.description:
A sophisticated woven carpet. It is also called Lynch Carpet because it is made of fleece from Lynch Ranch.

- Usage: Residence or Manor decor

- How to Obtain: Craft at a Furniture Workshop

24814.name: Large Carpet
24814.description:
A quite huge carpet. Despite its size, its color and thickness are consistent. Considered a high-quality luxury item, it can usually be found in noble households, big churches, or town hall offices.

- Usage: Residence or Manor decor

- How to Obtain: Craft at a Furniture Workshop

24815.name: Mediahn Carpet
24815.description:
An old and high-quality wool carpet made by an Artisan from Kusha. It is valued even higher due to the discontinuation.

- Usage: Residence or Manor decor

- How to Obtain: Craft at a Furniture Workshop

24816.name: Velian Carpet
24816.description:
A Velian carpet with a unique pattern that cannot be found elsewhere. A carpet made in Velia is such a rare product.

- Usage: Residence or Manor decor

- How to Obtain: Craft at a Furniture Workshop

24817.name: Serendian Carpet
24817.description:
A carpet traditionally offered to the Lord of Serendia. Names of the previous Lords are sewn on its edge.

- Usage: Residence or Manor decor

- How to Obtain: Craft at a Furniture Workshop

24818.name: Calpheon Artisanal Carpet
24818.description:
A handcrafted carpet by a Calpheonian Artisan. From its size to pattern, even its finish; everything about it is unique.

- Usage: Residence or Manor decor

- How to Obtain: Craft at a Furniture Workshop

24819.name: Floor Carpet
24819.description:
An old floor carpet. Its unique pattern is still solid even with a lot of stain.

- Usage: Residence or Manor decor

- How to Obtain: Craft at a Furniture Workshop

24820.name: Luxurious Carpet
24820.description:
A tastefully toned carpet. The color will not fade easily due to the rare dye material used on it.

- Usage: Residence or Manor decor

- How to Obtain: Craft at a Furniture Workshop

24841.name: Ancient Kamel Statue
24841.description:
A decoration that can be installed in your residence.
Interacting with this item will give you a buff and consume its Durability.
- Special Function: All AP +9 for 1 hr directly after use.

24847.name: Duvencrune Three Wood Display Stand
24847.description: It is crafted using wood from Duvencrune. This display stand is made from the trunks of three different trees. It is sturdier than it looks, but it is vulnerable to moisture so it needs to be well-kept.

24848.name: Duvencrune Beam Stand
24848.description: This beam display stand was made by chance, when someone from Duvencrune miscounted how many beams he needed to build his house and used the leftover wood to make a stand. It is sturdy and looks high-end, and not like an afterthought at all.

24849.name: Duvencrune Multipurpose Toolbox
24849.description: This toolbox is especially popular with homebodies of Duvencrune because it doesn't take up much space yet contains a great variety of tools. It is very handy, and people tend to customize what kind of tools they like to keep in the toolbox.

24850.name: Duvencrune Fabric Holder
24850.description: This fabric holder is made from simple, natural wood and is one of the most popular furniture items in Drieghan.

24851.name: Duvencrune Decoration Holder
24851.description: This furniture is steeped in the traditions of Duvencrune. Everyone of these are decorated in a unique way, as per tradition.

24852.name: Duvencrune Rhomboid Holder
24852.description: It is a rhombus-shaped furniture designed to hold fabric. Air circulates well through it. It used to primarily be used by those that handle a lot of fabric but now can also be found in everyday homes.

24853.name: Duvencrune Small Thuja Bookshelf
24853.description: This bookshelf is made from unprocessed Thuja wood, and it is designed for storing books and so on. It is not suitable if you own a large amount of books because of its small size.

24854.name: Duvencrune Large Thuja Bookshelf
24854.description: This bookshelf is made from unprocessed Thuja wood, and it is designed for storing books and so on. It is quite large, so it is not suitable if you have a small residence.

24855.name: Duvencrune Fragrant Bedside Table
24855.description: This bedside table is made from the trees growing around Duvencrune. It is not very processed, so the table still gives off a faint fragrance from the wood. It is especially popular among older people in Drieghan.

24856.name: Duvencrune Hardwood Bedside Table
24856.description: This bedside table was made from finely polishing wood grown around Duvencrune. It has an antique feel to it. It is open on one side for aesthetic reasons, but this means that anything you store within this bedside table will not be securely hidden out of sight.

24857.name: Duvencrune Lamp Bedside Table
24857.description: Its design was inspired by the lamps carried by Duvencrune investigators. This bedside table takes up little space yet is still very useful.

24858.name: Duvencrune Leaf Bedside Table
24858.description: This bedside table looks like a miniature bench. It is decorate with beautiful leaves and is very space-efficient.

24859.name: Duvencrune Giant Wood Wardrobe
24859.description: This giant wardrobe is designed to hold as many clothes as possible. The price is high due to the high amount of the processed Thuja wood used and the high quality of its decoration.

24860.name: Duvencrune Target Dining Table
24860.description: The archery targets that people in Drieghan used to practice with have been reworked into this dining table . It may seem unsophisticated but it bodes good omen for a successful hunt.

24861.name: Duvencrune Wooden Dining Table
24861.description: This splendid dining table was made a skilled woodworker who was inspired by a single falling comet in the night sky that she saw one night when she was working late. Although originally made to be a dining table, it is so beautifully crafted than it could be used for other purposes.

24862.name: Kamasylvian Lemoria Drawers
24862.description: Lemoria Guard Commander Helene Sana admires this piece and it is trying to make it become an object of admiration. It has ample storage space.

24863.name: Kamasylvian Grace Bedside Table
24863.description: A bedside table with drawn shapes inspired by the branches of Kamasylve and the grace of the goddess Sylvia. It releases a very delicate fragrance, and if used as a bedside table, it won't attract bugs or trap humidity.

24864.name: Kamasylvian Clock Stand
24864.description: A Fadus of Kamasylvia was trying to make a clock like the ones found in distant lands, but was unsuccessful. He called his failed experiment a "clock stand" and it can function as a bedside table.

24865.name: Kamasylvian Patterned Bedside Table
24865.description: A table with a simplified version of the light patterned shape created from the goddess Sylvia. Due to its size, it can be used in narrow residences.

24866.name: Kamasylvian Webbed Bedside Table
24866.description: The curved shape of the legs have the shape of a necklace that provides not only style but stability and resistance to this furniture.

24867.name: Kamasylvian Carved Bedside Table
24867.description: A cozy and simple bedside table. The head of the table is carved to provide a smooth and clean look.

24868.name: Kamasylvian Grove Partition
24868.description: Partition made by casting iron and copper ores, which are widely available and produced, with a Fadus's special Lapis Lazuli. The metal body makes it very durable, which is considered a great thing by outsiders. However, the Ganelle prefer products that are more delicate and lightweight.

24869.name: Kamasylvian Old Moon Round Table
24869.description: This table was inspired by the view of a waning moon above the beautiful Kamasylve tree. This is one of the most popular items among the furniture lovers.

24870.name: Smooth Kamasylvian Wooden Side Table
24870.description: This side table is made from finely polished wood. It is decorated with the image of Kamasylve. The light surrounding the Kamasylve tree represents the Ganelle and Vedir.

24871.name: Kamasylvian Melody Side Table
24871.description: When Atanis put up her instrument, a beautiful melody came out of it and, after hearing it a furniture artisan was inspired to make this side table to try capture the essence of that melody.

24872.name: Kamasylvian Compact Wine Jar
24872.description: This jar storing wine made from Kamasylvian grapes. The jar is designed to easily store and pour wine. It is available in dark and light tones according to the preference of the Ganelle.

24873.name: Kamasylvian Basic Wine Jar
24873.description: This jar storing wine made from Kamasylvian grapes. The jar is designed to easily store and pour wine. It is available in dark and light tones according to the preference of the Ganelle.

24874.name: Kamasylvian Wine Jar
24874.description: This jar storing wine made from Kamasylvian grapes. The jar is designed to store a large amount of wine for aging. It is an essential item for those who fancy a good wine.

24875.name: Kamasylvian Single Tiered Wine Rack
24875.description: A single-tiered wine rack made from Kamasylvian wood. It can even hold heavy wine jars.

24876.name: Kamasylvian Two-Tiered Wine Rack
24876.description: A two-tiered wine rack made from Kamasylvian wood. It can even hold heavy wine jars.

24877.name: Kamasylvian Multi-Tiered Wine Rack
24877.description: A multi-tiered wine rack made from Kamasylvian wood. It can even hold heavy wine jars.

24878.name: O'draxxia Glamorous Patterned Carpet
24878.description: A carpet with an elaborate pattern woven by the carpet artisans of O'draxxia that cannot be seen anywhere else. Rumor has it that laying out this carpet can protect one from calamities.

40434.name: Targak Steel Shard
40434.description:
A holy Targak Steel Shard. You can process Delphad Castillion weapon to make it even stronger.

- Usage: Craft Ultimate Delphad Castillion Weapon

- Crafting Method: Processing (Manufacture) - Heating

- Crafting Materials:
Delphad Castillion Weapon x1
Targak Steel Shard x1

- How to Obtain: Black Spirit's quest

40453.name: Kydict's Heirloom
40453.description:
You can use Kydict's Heirloom as an alchemy ingredient to create a special crystal.

- Crafting Method: Processing (Manufacture) - Simple Alchemy

- Usage #1: Craft Kydict's Crystal - Adventure

- Crafting Materials:
Kydict's Heirloom x10

- Usage #2: Craft Kydict's Crystal - Giant

- Crafting Materials:
Kydict's Heirloom x20
Ancient Magic Crystal - Cobelinus x1

- How to Obtain: Quest

41640.name: Boss White Wolf Lure Trap
41640.description:
Set up the trap at a specific spot to lure a Boss White Wolf.

※ The lured White Wolf will disappear after 10 min of idleness or 30 min after appearing.
※ There's no penalty for death while fighting a White Wolf.

※ Available from Lv. 50.

41641.name: Boss King Brown Bear Lure Trap
41641.description:
Set up the trap at a specific spot to lure a Boss King Brown Bear.

※ The lured King Brown Bear will disappear after 10 min of idleness or 30 min after appearing.
※ There's no penalty for death while fighting a King Brown Bear.

※ Available from Lv. 50.

42094.name: Chenga Crystal of Wisdom
42094.description:
A mythical crystal given only to those who have grasped all of Chenga's wisdom. A supernatural and mystical power circles within the crystal.
"A great bolt of lightning split the ground and gave rise to the Sherekhans, founders of Drieghan and slayers of Dragons."

- Usage: Craft Chenga - Sherekhan Tome of Wisdom

- Crafting Method: Processing (Manufacture) - Simple Alchemy

- Crafting Materials:
Chenga Crystal of Wisdom x1
Adventurer's Tome x1

- How to Obtain: Complete the Legendary Leveling with Chenga and Quests questline

42354.name: High-quality Wine
42354.description: A high-quality liquor made from the best grapes in the land. A favorite among nobles.

42395.name: Askasha's Broken Magic Weapon I
42395.description: An enchanted weapon. Unfortunately, it is broken.

42396.name: Askasha's Broken Magic Weapon II
42396.description: An enchanted weapon. Unfortunately, it is broken.

42397.name: Askasha's Broken Magic Weapon III
42397.description: An enchanted weapon. Unfortunately, it is broken.

42432.name: Pattern-Engraved Golden Armor
42432.description: A specially crafted golden armor. It is used to make Jarette's Armor.

42433.name: Finest Casual Clothes for Women
42433.description: Women's casual clothes of the finest quality. It is made in Serendia, and it is for making Jarette's Armor.

42434.name: Serendia Special Fabric
42434.description: Special fabric from Serendia. It is used for making Jordine's Casual.

42435.name: Latent Boss Aura
42435.description:
A piece containing some of boss aura. Collect and put them together to obtain a powerful weapon exuding boss aura.

- Usage #1: Weekly quest from Jetina
 Exchange Latent Boss Aura x2 for Concentrated Boss Crystal x155

- Usage #2: Exchange with Jetina at all times
 Exchange Latent Boss Aura x3 for Concentrated Boss Crystal x180

- Usage #3: Exchange with blacksmiths in major cities or Velia

 <Exchange List>
 - x1: Memory Fragment x1
 - x100: Kzarka's Sealed Weapon Box
 - x100: Nouver's Sealed Sub-weapon Box
 - x100: Dandelion Weapon Box
 - x100: Kutum's Sealed Sub-weapon Box
 - x100: Offin Tett's Light Sealed Weapon Box
 - x100: Giath's Helmet
 - x100: Griffon's Helmet
 - x100: Dim Tree Spirit's Armor
 - x100: Red Nose's Armor
 - x100: Bheg's Gloves
 - x100: Leebur's Gloves
 - x100: Muskan's Shoes
 - x100: Urugon's Shoes

 (Right-click to locate)

- How to Obtain: Defeat Cox Pirates' Ghost

43775.name: Mutant Loah Flower
43775.description:
A Mutant Loah Flower rarely found on Padix Island. When burned, the flower emits beautiful red smoke. Yet breathing in this red smoke directly can make one lose themselves, so caution is advised.

- Usage: Craft Mutant Loah Flower Neutralizer

- Crafting Method: Processing (Manufacture) - Simple Alchemy

- Crafting Materials:
Mutant Loah Flower x1
Highly Concentrated Herbal Juice x20
Fire Horn x35
Trace of Nature x70

- How to Obtain: Purchase from Hazelnut, general goods vendor of Kuit Islands

43780.name: Eye of Desolation
43780.description:
This items contains immense power.

Use it at the designated location to summon an atrocious boss.
※ Available from Lv. 56.
※ A quest will start when you use this item.
※ You cannot attack the summoned monster on servers with Node/Conquest Wars in progress.
※ You will not be penalized even if you die while fighting the boss.
(Right-click to locate)

Obtainable item:
Blackstar's Claw

※ You cannot use this item if you already have more than 30 quests in progress.
※ If you throw away this item, you will not be able to get another one.

43786.name: Remnants of the Rift
43786.description:
Unknown substance from the Dark Rift.

- How to Obtain: It can be obtained by grinding an alchemy stone.

44348.description:

- Crafting Materials:
Bird Meat x10
Weasel or Raccoon Meat x10

- Crafting Materials:
Bird Meat x10
Deer or Fox Meat x10

※ To hunt boss animals, you need specially made lure traps.

- How to Obtain: Purchase from a Material Vendor

44362.name: Garmoth's Heart
44362.description:
A crystal instilled with the concentrated fiery magic of Garmoth. While not the actual heart of Garmoth, it is popularly dubbed so due to the dragon's powerful magic contained within. The Black Stone's influence has made it bear a dark and murky hue.

※ You can accept a quest upon giving this item to Hughol, the blacksmith of Duvencrune.
(Right-click to locate)

 - Quest Information #1
 [Famliy] Orzeca Records: Time of Dragons - O'dyllita, <Thornwood Watch> Black Eyeroot
- Complete 14 chapters of the questline: Inverted Heart of Garmoth x1

 - Quest Information #2
 [Family] Happy Crimson Accident - Garmoth's Nest, <Fearless> Kukao
- Garmoth's Bloodstone x10: Garmoth's Heart x1

44368.name: Young Sea Monster's Spirit Pouch

※ The [Guild] Sea Monster's Spirit Pouch is a guild item and cannot be stored in personal storage.

Black Stone Powder x10

They say it can be used to stabilize any powerful energies.

- Usage: Crafting Krogdalo's Horse Gear - Sea

- How to Obtain: Defeat Sycraia Underwater Ruins and Protty Cave monsters

 (Right-click to locate)

44449.description:
A solution which neutralizes the dark energy within the Mutant Loah Flower. Once the flower comes in contact with the neutralizer, the energy within dissipates into blue smoke.

- How to obtain:
Purchase from Hazelnut, general goods vendor of Kuit Islands.

Use Simple Alchemy in the Processing window to combine Mutant Loah Flower x1, Highly Concentrated Herbal Juice x20, Fire Horn x35, and Trace of Nature x70 into Mutant Loah Flower Neutralizer x1.

- Usage:
Interact with the Loah Flower Pot within Padix Island to weaken the physical abilities of the Cox Pirates who are addicted to loah flowers.

- Crafting Materials:

※ How to Use
1. Right-click on this item and navigate to the nearest Guild Mount Manager.
2. Talk to the Guild Mount Manager and select "Stable."
3. Select "Register Mount." Right-click on the item.
4. Enter the mount's name and press "Yes" to register.
5. Select the registered mount and press "Take Out."

- How to Obtain:
 > Craft via a Cooking Utensil in your residence if at least Cooking Beginner 1.

- You can use this to grow your Fairy; it gives more EXP than other materials that can be used to grow your Fairy.
- [Additional client details unavailable offline]

※ Caution: Any attempt at making a Sweet Honey Wine without having first acquired knowledge of Sweet Honey Wine will result in failure regardless of whether the right ingredients were used, and all the ingredients used during the cooking attempt will be consumed.

- How to Obtain: Defeat Sea Monsters

56133.name: [Hunting] Sniper Rifle
56133.description:
A sniper rifle that can be used from Lv. 30 and either Hunting Apprentice 10 or Hunting Mastery 50.

It's used to hunt wild animals.
It has a range of 100 m. Shooting the head will cause more damage.

※ How to Use
- After equipping the rifle, press Jump and sit down and press Attack2 to switch to sniper mode.
- If you press Attack1 while in sniper mode, you will be able to aim more precisely. While maintaining Attack1, you will hold your breath. When your breath is exhausted, you will be kicked out of sniper mode.
- While maintaining Attack1, if your aim is on a target, the aim icon will turn red. Release Attack1 to fire.
- If the aim icon is not red, even if you shoot the target will not be damaged, as the target is out of range.
- Maintaining Attack1 will decrease the aiming icon will become smaller, and once all the circles of the icon merge the accuracy will be at maximum.
- A minigame will take place to reload the rifle. Once the color of the bullet becomes white, the minigame will stop and you'll go back to sniper mode.
- You'll switch to sniper mode after a certain time has passed even if you fail the minigame.
- During the reload minigame, the location of your bullet will be displayed on bottom left. A red aim icon will show up in sniper mode.
- Chance of hitting a bullet within the red aim icon increases with higher hunting mastery.

It can be enhanced with Black Stone.

<How to Obtain>
Complete Old Moon Guild's Trade Offer from Jetina, open your inventory and check out the Old Moon Guild's Support. You can obtain the item by selecting it from the UI that opens via said feature.

※ You can obtain guaranteed PEN (V) of this item via Old Moon Guild's Support.

The enhancement for the next level gear requires specific materials and can only be proceeded once the cup is extracted or removed.

705015.name: Manos Trainer's Clothes
705015.description:
Trainer's clothes made by infusing magical power into Manos stones, then sewing them into the clothes. Manos stones can absorb any substance. It increases Training Mastery.
- Depending on your Training Mastery, the following will increase: your chance of getting a higher tier horse from breeding, your chance of capturing horses, and the amount of EXP your mount gains.
- The above effects are not applied to mounts that do not level up by design.

- Required Enhancement Materials
+1 to +15: Black Gem
PRI (I) to PEN (V): Concentrated Magical Black Gem

※ Go to My Information > Life Skill tab to read more about Training Mastery.

705022.name: Manos Hunter's Clothes
705022.description:
Hunter's clothes made of tough animal hides and Manos stones, which can absorb any substances. They are designed to protect wearers against beast attacks. They increase Hunting Mastery.
- Your chance of obtaining more items when butchering a hunting monster or wild animal will increase based on your Hunting Mastery.
- Your chance of obtaining rare items when butchering will increase based on your Hunting Mastery.
- Your accuracy with a sniper rifle will increase based on your Hunting Mastery.
- You can use the following matchlocks regardless of your hunting level, if you have enough Hunting Mastery:
Hunting Mastery 50+: [Hunting] Sniper Rifle
Hunting Mastery 100+: [Hunting] Apprentice Matchlock
Hunting Mastery 200+: [Hunting] Skilled Matchlock
Hunting Mastery 300+: [Hunting] Professional Matchlock
Hunting Mastery 400+: [Hunting] Artisan Matchlock

- Required Enhancement Materials
+1 to +15: Black Gem
PRI (I) to PEN (V): Concentrated Magical Black Gem

※ Go to My Information > Life Skill tab to read more about Hunting Mastery.

705032.name: Manos Sailor's Clothes
705032.description:
Sailor's clothes made with Manos stones, which can absorb any substance. It increases Sailing Mastery.
- Speed/Acceleration/Turn/Brake ability of your big ship (excluding Galleys) will increase based on your Sailing Mastery.

- Required Enhancement Materials
+1 to +15: Black Gem
PRI (I) to PEN (V): Concentrated Magical Black Gem

※ Go to My Information > Life Skill tab to read more about Sailing Mastery.

705037.name: Manos Cook's Clothes
705037.description:
Cook's clothes made with Manos stones, which can absorb any substance. It increases Cooking Mastery.
- Your chance of activating mass cooking will increase based on your Cooking Mastery.
- Your chance of producing the max number of dishes will increase based on your Cooking Mastery.
- Your chance of producing a higher grade version of a dish, and getting the max number of that higher grade dish will increase based on your Cooking Mastery.
- Your chance of receiving extra profit when you turn in a cooking box to the Imperial Crafting Delivery will increase based on your Cooking Mastery.

- Required Enhancement Materials
+1 to +15: Black Gem
PRI (I) to PEN (V): Concentrated Magical Black Gem

※ Go to My Information > Life Skill tab to read more about Cooking Mastery.

- Your chance of producing additional basic, special, and rare items will increase based on your Alchemy Mastery.
- Your chance of obtaining extra profit when you turn in an alchemy box to the Imperial Crafting Delivery will increase based on your Alchemy Mastery.

- Required Enhancement Materials

719525.name: [Shai] Kanna's Naga Disguise
719525.description:
The merchants from Glish enjoy wearing this Naga disguise made by Kanna. The unusual design of the clothes is very eye-catching. Those wearing this disguise are sometimes mistaken for Naga.

※ If you use an Equipment Tailoring Coupon, you will get the same item as a costume, with an additional effect of Amity +15%. This costume can then be equipped in the outfit slot.

If you exchange it for a costume, you cannot register it on the Central Market.

719526.name: [Shai] Kanna's Naga Disguise (Costume)
719526.description:
Naga disguise that Kanna made herself for the Naga Enthusiasts Club. The unusual design of the clothes is very eye-catching. Those wearing this disguise are sometimes mistaken for Naga.

- Heat this item to extract Ancient Spirit's Crystal - Swiftness.

※ This is a functional costume and does not share the set effect with outfits.
※ The effects of this costume cannot be stacked with the Outfit Slot Equip Effect.

719544.description:

※ If you use an Equipment Tailoring Coupon, you will get the same item as a costume, with an additional effect of Amity +15%. This costume can then be equipped in the outfit slot.

719546.name: [Shai] Drieghanese Winter Clothes
719546.description:
Clothes like these are worn by Drieghanese people during the winter to protect the wearers from the cold mountain air.

※ If you use an Equipment Tailoring Coupon, you will get the same item as a costume, with an additional effect of Amity +15%. This costume can then be equipped in the outfit slot.

If you exchange it for a costume, you cannot register it on the Central Market.

719547.name: [Shai] Descendant of Sherekhan Outfit
719547.description:
A Descendant of Sherekhan outfit made using rare materials from Drieghan. The horns on the hat is a unique feature.

※ If you use an Equipment Tailoring Coupon, you will get the Descendant of Sherekhan outfit with an additional effect of Amity +15%. This costume can then be equipped in the outfit slot.

If you exchange it for a costume, you cannot register it on the Central Market.

719548.name: [Shai] Florin Cook's Clothes (Costume)
719548.description:
Clothes worn by cooks in Florin. It's made so that stains can be easily removed.

- Heat this item to extract Ancient Spirit's Crystal - Swiftness.

※ This is a functional costume and does not share the set effect with outfits.
※ The effects of this costume cannot be stacked with the Outfit Slot Equip Effect.

719549.name: [Shai] Florin Herb Gatherer Clothes (Costume)
719549.description:
These clothes are worn by herb gatherers in Florin, especially by those studying alchemy and herbal medicine.

- Heat this item to extract Ancient Spirit's Crystal - Valor.

※ This is a functional costume and does not share the set effect with outfits.
※ The effects of this costume cannot be stacked with the Outfit Slot Equip Effect.

721002.name: Ancient Spirit Dust
721002.description:
Dust used to purge black energy.

- Usage: Craft Caphras Stone

- Crafting Method: Processing (Manufacture) - Simple Alchemy

- Crafting Materials:
Ancient Spirit Dust x5
Black Stone x1

- Materials for x10:
Ancient Spirit Dust x50
Black Stone x10
Black Stone Powder x1

- Materials for x100:
Ancient Spirit Dust x500
Black Stone x100
Pure Powder Reagent x1

- How to Obtain: Quests, defeating monsters, or Gathering

721003.name: Caphras Stone
721003.description:
The immortal alchemist Caphras used stones as these as the ultimate catalyst. Sometimes referred to as the solar stone, the stone emits an intense and pure energy. It can be used to unlock the full potential of a gear without the risk of experiencing any dark, corrosive side effects.

- Usage: Increases the power of TRI (III) or higher gear via Caphras Enhancement

- Right-click to use

- How to Obtain: Quests, defeating monsters, Gathering, or Processing (Manufacture) - Simple Alchemy with the following materials

- Crafting Materials:
Ancient Spirit Dust x5
Black Stone x1

- Materials for x10:
Ancient Spirit Dust x50
Black Stone x10
Black Stone Powder x1

- Materials for x100:
Ancient Spirit Dust x500
Black Stone x100
Pure Powder Reagent x1

721009.name: Stabilized Magical Black Stone
721009.description:
A Calpheonian Alchemist, Gorgath, created a powerful new type of Black Stone. Gorgath was originally looking for a way to purify lifeforms tainted with black energy when he found dark crystals in the bodies of his experiments. He removed the crystals and found a way to stabilize their power.

- You can use this Black Stone to perform guaranteed enhancement on green-grade gear enhanced to +13-15.
Stones required for +13 gear: 5
Stones required for +14 gear: 8
Stones required for +15 gear: 13

- Able to Enhance: Main weapon, sub-weapon, awakening weapon, helmet, armor, gloves, shoes (no life skill gear)

- Right-click to use

- How to obtain: Dropped from World or Field Bosses
- Durability will decrease by 30 when you enhance with this stone. If a gear is reformed, you will need to use the same type of magic black stone that you would need for the non-reformed version of the gear.

721010.name: Cleansed Magical Black Stone
721010.description:
A Calpheonian Alchemist, Gorgath, created a powerful new type of Black Stone. Gorgath was originally looking for a way to purify lifeforms tainted with dark energy when he found black crystals in the bodies of his experiments. He removed the crystals and found a way to stabilize their power.

- You can use this Black Stone to perform guaranteed enhancement on blue-grade gear enhanced to +13-15.
Stones required for +13 gear: 5
Stones required for +14 gear: 8
Stones required for +15 gear: 13

- Able to Enhance: Main weapon, sub-weapon, awakening weapon, helmet, armor, gloves, shoes (no life skill gear)

- Right-click to use

- How to obtain: Dropped from World or Field Bosses
- Durability will decrease by 30 when you enhance with this stone. If a gear is reformed, you will need to use the same type of magic black stone that you would need for the non-reformed version of the gear.

721012.name: Atanis Firefly
721012.description:
Fireflies from Atanis Pond are blessed by Atanis, the spirit of tranquility.
Right-click to release the firefly and brighten up your surroundings for 1 hour.

721032.name: Bonfire Tool
721032.description:
A tool that can be used to set up a bonfire.

Right-click to make a bonfire.

- Effects:
 HP Recovery +25 to nearby allies for 10 sec
 Energy Recovery +1 to nearby allies for 10 sec
 Cure Hypothermia
- Duration: 30 min
- Cooldown: 30 min

Grants effects nearby a bonfire upon using the item.

※ You cannot use this item on a boat.

721044.name: Specter's Energy
721044.description:
The energy of a rather unstable specter that haunts Thornwood Forest.
Spirits that were burned by Sephir's Ahib will never find eternal slumber due to Turasil's influence. Bound forever to Thornwood Forest, they give off Grim Energy as they wander the lands.

※ This item emits energy that can only be handled by the best blacksmith of the continent, and is used to craft a Blackstar Awakening/Sub-weapon or Defense Gear.

757003.name: Flower of Oblivion
757003.description:
A flower with soft and gentle fragrance. Rumor has it that a whiff of the Flower of Oblivion can rejuvenate horses. By imperial order, only a small amount has been allowed for exchange as it is quite a dangerous compound that can render a person unconscious.

- Usage: Craft Mythical Powder (Material to craft Mythical Censer, which is used for Mythical Horse awakening attempt)

- Crafting Method: Processing (Manufacture) - Grinding

- Crafting Materials:
Flower of Oblivion x10
Royal Fern Root x10
Everlasting Herb x10
Fruit of Nature x10
Black Stone Powder x10

- How to Obtain: Imperial Horse Delivery of each tier excluding Dream Horses

757004.name: Royal Fern Root
757004.description:
A fern root that can be found commonly at the foot of a mountain. It is said that the roots can be ground finely and applied to wounds to ease pain.

- Usage #1: Exchange with Wapra at Stonetail Horse Ranch Wapra for Courser Training materials

- Usage #2: Craft Mythical Powder (a material used to craft a Mythical Censer for Mythical Horse awakening)

- Crafting Method: Processing (Manufacture) - Grinding

- Crafting Materials:
Flower of Oblivion x10
Royal Fern Root x10
Everlasting Herb x10
Fruit of Nature x10
Black Stone Powder x10

- How to Obtain:
<Wapra at Stonetail Horse Ranch>
Complete [Weekly] Fly Like the Wind
Complete [Beginner] - [Guru] No Worries for the Prepared

757005.name: Mythical Powder
757005.description:
Fine-grained powder from Royal Fern Root and Flower of Oblivion mixed with other different materials. Burning the powder in fire will produce out an addictive smoke that incapacitates a person who inhales it.

- Usage: Craft Mythical Censer
(For Mythical Horse awakening attempt)

- Crafting Method: Processing (Manufacture) - Manufacture

- Crafting Materials:

757007.description:
A censer decorated with extravagant patterns on the surface. The censer's heat is used to burn the incense by using tinder, charcoal, and various powders as fuel.

757008.description:
A censer burning the Mythical Powder with Powder of Flame lit by the Fire Horn. Take one whiff of the smoke and you won't be waking up until it has finished burning.

- Usage: Arduanatt, Diné or Doom Mythical Awakening

- How to Obtain: Processing (Manufacture) - Manufacture with the following materials

Mythical Powder x10
Mythical Feather x10

757010.name: Mythical Feather
757010.description:
A feather that can place Mythical Horses in deep sleep. Seldom found near Lakiaro, Mythical Horses are quite fond of this feather. A mere tickling of one's face is said to place even the most severe of insomniacs in heavy slumber.

- Usage: Craft Mythical Censer
(Used to attempt at obtaining Mythical Horse)

- Crafting Method: Processing (Manufacture) - Manufacture

- Crafting Materials:
Old Moon Censer x1

Mythical Feather x10
Fire Horn x10
Powder of Flame x10

- How to Obtain: Quests, Gathering, and Exchange

757031.name: Fiery Celerity Draught
757031.description:
A draught made by mixing the Celerity Draught with the Stonetail Tonic. One swig of this draught and it is said your untapped equestrian potential will awaken while mounted atop even the fastest of horses.

- Usage: Gain the draught's effects

- Effects:
 Mount EXP +30%
 Training EXP +30%

- Duration: 600 min
- Cooldown: 10 sec

※ Type: Draught

※ While the draught's effects are active, only the effects of perfumes, Whale Tendon Elixirs, and Tough Whale Tendon Elixirs will be stacked.
※ Only the effects of the last draught used will be applied.

- How to Obtain: Processing (Manufacture) - Simple Alchemy with the following materials

- Materials #1:
Stonetail Tonic x1
Celerity Draught x4

- Materials #2:
Stonetail Tonic x1
Unbridled Celerity Draught x2

757117.name: Pilgrim's Stone
757117.description:
A cracked stone obtained from drilling. It's a desert rarity. Pilgrims started to call it the Pilgrim's Stone because they thought of it as a sacred object that reflects light with blinding intensity.

- Usage: Obtain Sharp Black Crystal Shard x2-5, or Mass of Pure Magic x1

- Crafting Method: Processing (Manufacture) - Grinding

- Crafting Materials:
Pilgrim's Stone x1

- How to Obtain: Guild Drill

757129.description:

- Usage: Craft Depleted Cloud's Power Stone, Buried Earth's Power Stone, Weathered Mount's Power Stone, or Traces of Time Fossil Fragment

- Crafting Method: Processing (Manufacture) - Grinding

- Crafting Materials:
Dirt-caked Rock x1

- How to Obtain: Guild Drill

757223.name: Bloodlit Eye of the Desert
757223.description:
A stone discovered not too long after all the blood shed from the Valencia War was absorbed deep into the desert sands. Appears to have been made from the hardened blood crystalizing with the sand. The shape of the stone itself is akin to an actual eye, and rumors say that it bears the sorrows of those lost in battle.

- Usage: Craft Bloodstorm Black Stone

- Crafting Method: Processing (Manufacture) - Heating

- Crafting Materials:
Bloodlit Eye of the Desert x1
Black Stone x100

- How to Obtain: Defeat Bloodstorm Nouver

757224.name: Bloodstorm Black Stone
757224.description:
A black stone bearing a stormy aura of blood. Said to be required to complete a special piece of dormant gear with a mighty power hidden within.

- Usage: Enhance Dormant Nouverikant Helmet and Armor

- Right-click to start enhancement.

- How to Obtain: Processing (Manufacture) - Heating with the following materials
Bloodlit Eye of the Desert x1
Black Stone x100

760943.name: Manos Sailing Log
760943.description:
A sailing log crafted with the Manos Stone, which can absorb any substance. It increases Sailing Mastery.
- Speed/Acceleration/Turn/Brake ability of your big ship will increase based on your Sailing Mastery.

- Required Enhancement Materials
 +1 to +15: Black Stone
 PRI (I) to PEN (V): Concentrated Magical Black Stone

- This item's durability must be at least 100 to receive a ship speed buff.

※ Go to My Information > Life Skill tab to learn more about Sailing Mastery.

761075.description:
An alchemy stone condensed with Behelit's energy and Vell's potent magic.

- Effects:
 All AP +8
 All Accuracy +10
 Attack Speed +5%
 Casting Speed +5%

- How to Use: Right-click to equip Behelit's Heart in your Inventory, then press (AlchemyStone) to use. Cannot be used with other alchemy/spirit stones, except Life types.

- Duration: 5 min
- Cooldown: 5 min

- Fuel: Vell's Fine Powder, Mystical Spirit Powder
※ Use the Recharge/Polish/Grow Alchemy Stone button at the bottom right of your Inventory to recharge, polish, or grow your alchemy stone.

761392.name: Essence of Ascent - Accessory
761392.description:
Essence filled with countless experiences from old adventures. It's said that using it on an accessory can push beyond limits to reach a new level.

- Usage: A non-seasonal character can perform a guaranteed enhancement of a PEN (V) Tuvala accessory to a HEX (VI) Tuvala accessory through the Black Spirit.

- Required Amount for HEX (VI) Enhancement: x1

- Enhancement Available Items: PEN (V) Tuvala necklace, ring, belt, and earring usable by non-seasonal characters.

- Enhanced HEX (VI) Tuvala accessories can be further enhanced to DEC (X) with Essence of Dawn, and DEC (X) Tuvala accessories can be exchanged for a non-tradable TET (IV) Kharazad accessory.

- Right-click to use

- Enhancing with the above item does not consume durability.

- Usage #2: Craft Essence of Dawn x30

- Crafting Method: Processing (Manufacture) - Heating

- Material:
Essence of Ascent - Accessory x1

- How to Obtain: Obtainable as a quest reward from Fughar by completing a quest with the graduation cap received as a season graduation reward.

An alchemy stone condensed with the life force of the Shining Alchemy Stone and Khan's magic.

- Effects:
 Life EXP +30%
 Alchemy/Cooking Time -2.5 sec
 Processing Success Rate +25%
 Weight Limit +120 LT
 Gathering/Fishing Speed +3
 Gathering Item Drop Rate +25%

- How to Use: Right-click to equip Khan's Heart in your Inventory, then press (AlchemyStone) to use. Cannot be used with other alchemy/spirit stones, except Destruction/Protection types.

- Duration: 10 min
- Cooldown: 10 min

- Fuel: Oils, bloods, reagents, Mystical Spirit Powder, Vell's Fine Powder
※ Use the Recharge/Polish/Grow Alchemy Stone button at the bottom right of your Inventory to recharge, polish, or grow your alchemy stone.

※ Use the Recharge/Polish/Grow Alchemy Stone button at the bottom right of your Inventory to recharge, polish, or grow your alchemy stone.

767076.name: Flame of the Primordial
767076.description:
A primordial flame imbued with the energy of the sun that illuminates all creation which was birthed in ancient times, when the heavens and the earth were torn asunder.

Flame of the Primordial x1
Magical Shard x20

- How to Obtain: Morning Light World Boss subjugation reward

767077.name: Gem of Twilight

790584.name: Dehkia's Lantern Tier 1
790584.description:
An artifact discovered in Atoraxxion, the last stronghold of the Ancients to fight against the Dark Invaders. It was named after its founder, Dehkia. The targets exposed to Dehkia's Lantern awaken violently because their minds are tainted by the void.

※ Dehkia's Light recovers 1 durability of Dehkia's Lantern Tier 1 that can be used at a designated location.
※ Dehkia's Lantern will automatically be disabled when Node/Conquest War starts.
※ You can find which locations are affected by Dehkia's Lantern in the Monster Zone Info window.
※ The durability decreases by 1 on use.

- Cooldown: 1 min

- How to Craft #1: Processing (Manufacture) - Manufacture with the following materials
Magical Shard x300
Magical Lightstone Crystal x500
Copper Ingot x1,000
Dehkia's Light x1,000
Black Crystal x1,000

- How to Craft #2: Processing (Manufacture) - Simple Alchemy with the following materials
Dehkia's Lantern Tier 2 x1
Dehkia's Light x300

※ How to obtain Dehkia's Light: Use Heating on certain yellow-grade PRI (I), DUO (II), and TRI (III) accessories and Magical Lightstone Crystals. The number of Dehkia's Light obtained varies depending on the type of accessory and its enhancement level.

- How to Craft Dehkia's Light
#1: Yellow-grade PRI (I) Accessory x1, Magical Lightstone Crystal x10
#2: Yellow-grade DUO (II) Accessory x1, Magical Lightstone Crystal x10
#3: Yellow-grade TRI (III) Accessory x1, Magical Lightstone Crystal x10

820001.name: Design: Flondor Stage
820001.description:
A design for the stage on which the first-ever performance of the wondrous Atanis instruments was held. Patrigio had the stage hidden away, but since its true owner has been found, he wants the world to know of the stage.

- Usage: Craft a [Manor] Flondor Stage in a Lv. 5 Furniture Workshop.
- Crafting Materials
 Design: Flondor Stage x1
 Flondor's Pedestal x1
 Flondor's Star Decoration x1

※ Once you finish crafting all six concert hall pieces for your manor, you can exchange 150 Energy for an additional design from Stella.

820002.name: Design: Flondor Three-tiered Starry Risers
820002.description:
A design for three-tiered starry risers on which everyone gathered to enjoy music. Murizera who settled in Port Grándiha hid away the starry risers, but since the true owner has been found, she wants to let the world know of the risers.

- Usage: Craft a [Manor] Flondor Three-tiered Starry Risers in a Lv. 5 Furniture Workshop.
- Crafting Materials
 Design: Flondor Three-tiered Starry Risers x1
 Sturdy Snow White Stone x40
 Shattered Star Fragment x5
 Pure Gold Crystal x10
 Platinum Ingot x10

※ Once you finish crafting all six concert hall pieces for your manor, you can exchange 150 Energy for an additional design from Stella.

820003.name: Design: Flondor Three-tiered Foliage Risers
820003.description:
A design for three-tiered foliage risers where everyone gathered in front of the stage to enjoy music. The foliage risers have been hidden away, but since the true owner has been found, Shakatu wants to let the world know of the risers.

- Usage: Craft a [Manor] Flondor Three-tiered foliage Risers in a Lv. 5 Furniture Workshop.
- Crafting Materials
 Design: Flondor Three-tiered foliage Risers x1
 Sturdy Maple Plywood x8
 Plywood Hardener x6
 Moss Tree Sap x50
 Shining Powder x50

※ Once you finish crafting all six concert hall pieces for your manor, you can exchange 150 Energy for an additional design from Stella.

820004.name: Design: Flondor Jukebox
820004.description:
A design for a jukebox that added to the beautiful melody during the first-ever performance of the wondrous Atanis instruments. The jukebox has been hidden away, but since it has met its true owner, Karin wants to let the world know of the jukebox.

- Usage: Craft a [Manor] Flondor Jukebox in a Lv. 5 Furniture Workshop.
- Crafting Materials
 Design: Flondor Jukebox x1
 Sturdy Snow White Stone x20
 Gold Ingot x5
 Pure Gold Crystal x10
 Powder of Darkness x100

※ Once you finish crafting all six concert hall pieces for your manor, you can exchange 150 Energy for an additional design from Stella.

820005.name: Design: Flondor Dais
820005.description:
A design for a dais on which the first-ever performance of the wondrous Atanis instruments was held. The dais has been hidden away, but since its true owner has been found, Lisae now wants the world to know of the dais.

- Usage: Craft a [Manor] Flondor Dais in a Lv. 5 Furniture Workshop.
- Crafting Materials
 Design: Flondor Dais x1
 Flondor Round Carpet x1
 Flondor Round Pedestal x1

※ Once you finish crafting all six concert hall pieces for your manor, you can exchange 150 Energy for an additional design from Stella.

820006.name: Design: Flondor Blessed Chair
820006.description:
A design for a blessed chair upon which the spectator of the first-ever performance of the wondrous Atanis instruments sat. Philiberto LiPonti hid the chair away, but since the true owner of it has been found, he now he wants to let the world know of the chair.

- Usage: Craft a [Manor] Flondor Blessed Chair in a Lv. 5 Furniture Workshop.
- Crafting Materials
 Design: Flondor Blessed Chair x1
 Flondor Snow White Chair x1
 Flondor Snow White Stand x1

※ Once you finish crafting all six concert hall pieces for your manor, you can exchange 150 Energy for an additional design from Stella.

820007.name: Flondor's Pedestal
820007.description:
A pedestal with a surface and decorations as white as snow. Any beholder would love to perform on top of it.

- How to Obtain: Can be crafted in a Lv. 5 Furniture Workshop.
- Crafting Materials
 Sturdy Snow White Stone x100
 Sturdy Pine Plywood x8
 Plywood Hardener x5

- Usage: Craft a [Manor] Flondor Stage in a Lv. 5 Furniture Workshop.
- Crafting Materials
 Design: Flondor Stage x1
 Flondor's Pedestal x1
 Flondor's Star Decoration x1

※ Once you finish crafting all six concert hall pieces for your manor, you can exchange 150 Energy for an additional design from Stella.

820008.name: Flondor's Star Decoration
820008.description:
A partition decorated with stars made to make the stage appear more fancy. The red curtains look dashing next to the white walls.

- How to Obtain: Can be crafted in a Lv. 5 Furniture Workshop.
- Crafting Materials
 [Manor] Shattered Star Partition x1
 Pure Gold Crystal x10
 Silk Drapeless Curtain x1

- Usage: Craft a [Manor] Flondor Stage in a Lv. 5 Furniture Workshop.
- Crafting Materials
 Design: Flondor Stage x1
 Flondor's Pedestal x1
 Flondor's Star Decoration x1

※ Once you finish crafting all six concert hall pieces for your manor, you can exchange 150 Energy for an additional design from Stella.

820009.name: Flondor Round Carpet
820009.description:
A carpet made of red silk with yellow-tinted borders. It appears the carpet was made for a performer to stand on.

- How to Obtain: Can be crafted via Shaking.
- Crafting Materials
 Cotton Fabric x100
 Oil of Regeneration x10

- Usage: Craft a [Manor] Flondor Dais in a Lv. 5 Furniture Workshop.
- Crafting Materials
 Design: Flondor Dais x1
 Flondor Round Carpet x1
 Flondor Round Pedestal x1

※ Once you finish crafting all six concert hall pieces for your manor, you can exchange 150 Energy for an additional design from Stella.

820010.name: Flondor Round Pedestal
820010.description:
A dais for one person to perform on. The golden decorations add a bit of flair to the white dais.

- How to Obtain: Can be crafted in a Lv. 5 Furniture Workshop.
- Crafting Materials
 Sturdy Snow White Stone x70
 Pure Gold Crystal x20
 Brass Ingot x20
 Shining Powder x30

- Usage: Craft a [Manor] Flondor Dais in a Lv. 5 Furniture Workshop.
- Crafting Materials
 Design: Flondor Dais x1
 Flondor Round Carpet x1
 Flondor Round Pedestal x1

※ Once you finish crafting all six concert hall pieces for your manor, you can exchange 150 Energy for an additional design from Stella.

820011.name: Flondor Snow White Chair
820011.description:
A Snow White Chair which beautifully combines white hides with a golden frame. A tantalizing chair for any beholder's behind.

- How to Obtain: Can be crafted in a Lv. 5 Furniture Workshop.
- Crafting Materials
 Soft Ferri Feather x100
 Supreme Soft Hide x2
 Alluvial Gold x100
 Sturdy Pine Plywood x4

- Usage: Craft a [Manor] Flondor Blessed Chair in a Lv. 5 Furniture Workshop.
- Crafting Materials
 Design: Flondor Blessed Chair x1
 Flondor Snow White Chair x1
 Flondor Snow White Stand x1

※ Once you finish crafting all six concert hall pieces for your manor, you can exchange 150 Energy for an additional design from Stella.

820012.name: Flondor Snow White Stand
820012.description:
A Snow White Stand with gold tinted borders and surface as white as snow. It looks like you could place any item on top of it.

- How to Obtain: Can be crafted in a Lv. 5 Furniture Workshop.
- Crafting Materials
 Sturdy Snow White Stone x40
 Alluvial Gold x50
 Pure Gold Crystal x20

- Usage: Craft a [Manor] Flondor Blessed Chair in a Lv. 5 Furniture Workshop.
- Crafting Materials
 Design: Flondor Blessed Chair x1
 Flondor Snow White Chair x1
 Flondor Snow White Stand x1

※ Once you finish crafting all six concert hall pieces for your manor, you can exchange 150 Energy for an additional design from Stella.

820015.name: Nadia Rowen's Special Sauce
820015.description:
A special sauce developed by Nadia Rowen who learned how to cook from David Finto. Add some of this sauce and you'll be able cook up large portions that taste delicious, too! Nadia wanted many people to experience delicious cuisine and came up with this sauce. It's available at your local food vendor and is an ingredient used in Simple Cooking.

- Usage: Mass process Cron and Marvelous meals

- Crafting Method: Processing (Manufacture) - Simple Cooking

- Ingredients:
Cron or Marvelous meal ingredients x10
Nadia Rowen's Special Sauce x1

- How to Obtain: Purchase from Food Vendor

- Requires at least Cooking Skilled 1

820017.name: Rawr-Rawr's Heart
820017.description:
A crystal that contains the source of Rawr-Rawr's strength. Brimming with life energies, it bears the name of the mighty king of the Grass Rhinos.

- Usage: Craft Gauche Rawr-Rawr's Heart

- Crafting Method: Processing (Manufacture) - Heating

- Crafting Materials:
Rawr-Rawr's Heart x1
Forest Fury x3
Magical Shard x10
Black Stone x100
Steel x200

- How to Obtain: Hunt Rawr-Rawr

820018.name: Gauche Rawr-Rawr's Heart
820018.description:
A crystal that was refined with the life energies that flows through Rawr-Rawr's Heart. It is used to increase the max durability of [Hunting] Master Matchlock and [Hunting] Marni Sniper Rifle.

- How to Obtain: Crafting

- Crafting Method: Processing (Manufacture) - Heating

- Materials:
Rawr-Rawr's Heart x1
Forest Fury x3
Magical Shard x10
Black Stone x100
Steel x200

You can upgrade items by summoning the Black Spirit.
Gauche Rawr-Rawr's Heart can be used to reform [Hunting] Master Matchlock and [Hunting] Marni Sniper Rifle.
You will have a 100% chance of successfully reforming [Hunting] Master Matchlock and [Hunting] Marni Sniper Rifle.
Right-click to start item reform.

※ Gauche Rawr-Rawr's Heart x1 will be consumed per item reform attempt. The reformed [Hunting] Gauche Master Matchlock and [Hunting] Gauche Marni Sniper Rifle will have the following effect(s):

- [Hunting] Master Matchlock, [Hunting] Marni Sniper Rifle
Max Durability +50

820020.name: Fused Crystal of Emotions
820020.description:
A crystal discovered not long after the moon rose over the night sky of an Elvia Realm consumed by Hadum. It appears to be tangled in complicated emotions such as rage, sorrow, and anguish.

- Usage: Craft Refined Essence of Emotions used to extract cup item from certain reformed accessories

- Crafting Method: Processing (Manufacture) - Heating

- Crafting Materials:
Forest Fury x10
Fused Crystal of Emotions x20
Magical Shard x200

- How to Obtain #1: Purchase from NPC Wacky Toshi or blacksmith

- How to Obtain #2: Craft with all 3 Shard of the Night item types

- Crafting Method: Processing (Manufacture) - Heating

- Crafting Materials:
Shard of the Furious Night x1
Shard of the Tearful Night x1
Shard of the Drained Night x1

820021.name: Refined Essence of Emotions
820021.description:
A refined crystal tangled in emotions such as rage, sorrow, and anguish. You can use its energies to return a cup item to its original form.

- Usage: Extract the cup item from the following reformed accessories
<Reform stone can be extracted via blacksmith NPCs.>

- Extractable Accessories
Moonlit Necklaces
Dawnbound Necklaces
Clouded Rings
Starlit Rings
Sunstarved Rings
Tidal Belts
Nightfallen Belts
Duskborne Belts
Arboreal Earrings
Moonhushed Earrings

- How to Obtain: Crafting

- Crafting Method: Processing (Manufacture) - Heating

- Crafting Materials:
Forest Fury x10
Fused Crystal of Emotions x20
Magical Shard x200

820022.name: Sturdy Forest Tread
820022.description:
A crystal with a faint vermilion hue. You can feel the energy of the forest from it. It is called "the dew of the vermilion forest," because of it's dewdrop shape.

- Crafting Method: Processing (Manufacture) - Simple Alchemy
- Use Ibellab's Essence x1 and 10 times the materials listed below to craft 10 times.

- Usage #1: Craft Sturdy Whale Tendon Potion

- Materials #1:
Sturdy Forest Tread x1
Whale Tendon Potion x3

- Materials #2:
Sturdy Forest Tread x1
Superior Whale Tendon Potion x1

- Usage #2: Craft Sturdy Whale Tendon Elixir

- Materials #1:
Sturdy Forest Tread x2
Whale Tendon Elixir x3

- Materials #2:
Sturdy Forest Tread x2
Tough Whale Tendon Elixir x1

- How to Obtain #1: Reward from defeating monster summoned via Manshaum Narc's Stone (assemble Manshaum Voodoo Dolls)

- How to Obtain #2: Exchange with Peridot Petal x50 via Old Wisdom Tree> Variel or <Stonetail Horse Ranch> Shamhain

820040.name: Kuadir Fragment
820040.description:
A substance found all over Ulukita which was a part of the Kuadir, the hammers used by ancient Uluans as a means of training their bodies.
The Society of Equilibrium recently discovered that these fragments hold the skills of ancient Kabua and revealed a method to enhance special crystals with them.

- Usage: Craft Visionary Crystal of Elkarr

- Crafting Method: Processing (Manufacture) - Simple Alchemy
Kuadir Fragment x1
Crystal of Elkarr x2
Magical Shard x50
Magical Lightstone Crystal x100

820101.name: Scarlet Rosebay
820101.description:
A natural resource that can be altered by alchemical process.

 - How to Obtain: It can be produced at Byeot County. It can also be directly gathered from Scarlet Rosebay using bare hands or a hoe.

 ※ Consuming this item without Cooking will grant a special buff, but you may be poisoned!

820139.description:

Jujube x5
Youngji Mushroom x5

※ You can rent a special fence appropriate for intensive agriculture from an Old Moon Manager if you are at least Farming Master 1.

820856.name: Moodle Gukbap
820856.description:
The original Moodle Village Gukbap cooked with Big Auntie Wolim's secret recipe. A meat gukbap, or rice stew. A clove of garlic gets rid of the smell of pork while a bit of rice flour thickens the soup and gives it the milky color. It's always voted No.1 in the yearly list of favorite dishes among those who work at the Nampo Shipyard.

 Gives you an immediate boost of Breath EXP.
 Available up to Breath Lv. 40.
- Cooldown: 240 min

- How to Obtain: Craft via a Cooking Utensil in your residence if at least Cooking Artisan 1 with the knowledge of Moodle Gukbap.

※ Caution: Any attempt to cook Moodle Gukbap before learning its knowledge from <Big Auntie of Moodle> Wolim will fail—and all ingredients used will be consumed.

- Ingredients:
Rice Flour x2
Cooked Rice x1
Mineral Water x1
Garlic x2
Pork x3

820857.description:

 Gives you an immediate boost of Strength EXP.
 Available up to Strength Lv. 40.
- Cooldown: 240 min

- How to Obtain: Craft via a Cooking Utensil in your residence if at least Cooking Artisan 1 with the knowledge of Dalbeol Gukbap.

 Gives you an immediate boost of Health EXP.

820891.description:

- Usage: Craft Panokseon
Used at the Shipyard in Moodle Village to make Panokseon.

- How to Obtain
Accept the quest [Weekly] Pirate Trouble from the Yooan, the wharf manager at Moodle Village, then accept reward upon completion.

820892.name: Wooden Nail Soaked in Seawater
820892.description:
Wooden nails used as pegs when building a Panokseon, hammered between the joints to secure them. As the wood gets wet, it swells, increasing the strength of the joint. It also maintains flexibility due to the unique nature of wood as a material. Even if a wooden nail becomes damaged, you can always whittle away the damaged part and reinsert it.

- Usage: Craft Panokseon
Used at the Shipyard in Moodle Village to make Panokseon.

- How to Obtain
Defeat Goldmont Small/Medium/Large Battleship

820893.description:

- Usage #1: Craft Panokseon
Used at the Shipyard in Moodle Village to make Panokseon.

- Usage #2: Craft Panokseon equipment

Used to craft upgrade parts for a Panokseon at Byukgye Ship Part Workshop in Moodle Village.

- How to Obtain
Exchange with Sangpyeong Coin x10 from the Yooan, the wharf manager at Moodle Village.

820894.name: Glue With Traces of Deep Waves

- Usage #2: Craft Blessing of Mystic Beasts - Scroll

- Crafting Method: Processing (Manufacture) - Simple Alchemy

Lightstone (any type) x1
Remnants of Mystic Beasts x10
Mystical Parchment x10 OR Supreme Hide x100
Magical Lightstone Crystal x350

Lightstone of Wind: Heart = Blessing of Mystic Beasts - Max HP

821248.name: Piece of Edana
821248.description:
A piece of rare metal from the ancient age of the Edanas, used to awaken the power of the "true Edana." Legends say an immortal being once forged armaments from it to rise against the evil god.

- Usage #1: Craft Edana's Defense Gear

- Crafting Method
1. Complete Edania Main Quest [Aetherion] Return.
2. Complete the questline starting with [Edana's Defense Gear] A Piece of Secret via the Black Spirit.
3. Accept the crafting quest via Edana's Fragment at Litovan Mountains while in possession of a Piece of Edana and one of the following gear pieces.

- Wailing Slumbering Origin Defense Gear (any type, per slot)
- Obliterating Slumbering Origin Defense Gear (any type, per slot)

※ Wailing Slumbering Origin Defense Gear = +0 Edana's Defense Gear
※ Obliterating Slumbering Origin Defense Gear = NOV (IX) Edana's Defense Gear
※ You can craft the defense gear once a week after completing the "[Aetherion] Return" quest.

- Usage #2: Craft Edana's Black Stone

- Crafting Method: Processing (Manufacture) - Heating

- Materials:
Piece of Edana x1
Sharp Black Crystal Shard x3
Caphras Stone x20

※ You can Mass Process with 10x the usual amount of materials and 1 Black Stone Powder per batch.

- How to Obtain: Defeat Bosses in Edania

821249.name: Edana's Black Stone
821249.description:
This item can be used to enhance Edana's Defense Gear via the Black Spirit.

- Usage #1: Enhance Edana's Defense Gear

※ Max durability will decrease by 20 for failed enhancement.

- Usage #2: Craft Piece of Edana

- Crafting Method: Processing (Manufacture) - Heating

- Materials:
Edana's Black Stone x1

- How to Obtain: Processing (Manufacture) - Heating with the following materials

- Materials:
Piece of Edana x1
Sharp Black Crystal Shard x3
Caphras Stone x20

※ You can Mass Process with 10x the usual amount of materials and 1 Black Stone Powder per batch.

821250.name: Herald's Crystal
821250.description:
A crystal faintly imbued with the energy of the herald guiding the end times. A mysterious resonance pulses from within.

- Usage: Craft Flawless Herald's Crystal

- Crafting Method: Processing (Manufacture) - Heating

- Materials:
Herald's Crystal x100
Sharp Black Crystal Shard x100
Magical Shard x100
Magical Lightstone Crystal x200

- How to Obtain: Defeat monsters in Edania

821251.name: Flawless Herald's Crystal
821251.description:
A crystal imbued with the energy of the herald guiding the end times. A distant resonance pulses gently from within.

- Usage: Reform the following artifacts
Kabua's Artifact
Dehkia's Artifact - All Damage Reduction
Dehkia's Artifact - All Evasion

※ Kabua's Heralding Artifact Additional Effect:
Extra AP Against Monsters +3
Monster Damage Reduction +5
Max HP +250

※ Dehkia's Heralding Artifact Additional Effect:
All AP +6
Max HP +250

※ You can upgrade items by summoning the Black Spirit.
※ You will have a 100% chance of successfully reforming an item.
※ Right-click to start item reform.

※ Flawless Herald's Crystal x1 will be consumed per reform attempt. The reformed Heralding Artifacts will have additional effects.
※ Heralding Artifacts cannot be reformed any further.
※ Visit a blacksmith and use the Mirror of Equilibrium to extract the Flawless Herald's Crystal from a Heralding Artifact, retaining both the crystal and unreformed artifact.

- How to Obtain: Processing (Manufacture) - Heating with the following materials
Herald's Crystal x100
Sharp Black Crystal Shard x100
Magical Shard x100
Magical Lightstone Crystal x200

821252.name: Crystallized Energy of Endtimes
821252.description:

- Usage #1: Craft HAN Dawn Crystal

- Crafting Method: Processing (Manufacture) - Heating

- Materials:
JIN Dawn Crystal (any type) x1
Crystallized Energy of Endtimes x100
Magical Shard x300

Magical Shard x50
Magical Lightstone Crystal x100

- How to Obtain: Defeat monsters in Edania

821256.description:

- How to Obtain: Caphras Tree Lumbering or Fluid Collecting

- Materials #2:

821322.name: Brimming Essence of Aether
821322.description:

- Usage #1: Alchemy Stone Growth

※ If growth fails, half of the stone's current polishing points will be lost.

- Usage #2: Craft Resplendent, Splendid, or Shining Vell's Heart or Khan's Heart: Destruction, Protection, Life

- Crafting Method for Materials #1 to #3: Processing (Manufacture) - Simple Alchemy

- Materials #1:
Vell's Heart or Khan's Heart: Destruction x1
Resplendent, Splendid, or Shining Alchemy Stone of Destruction x1
Brimming Essence of Aether x1

- Materials #2:
Khan's Heart: Protection x1
Resplendent, Splendid, or Shining Alchemy Stone of Protection x1
Brimming Essence of Aether x1

- Materials #3:
Khan's Heart: Life x1
Resplendent, Splendid, or Shining Alchemy Stone of Life x1
Brimming Essence of Aether x1

- Usage #3: Craft (Recover) the alchemy stones used in Usage #2

- Crafting Method: Processing (Manufacture) - Simple Alchemy

- Materials:
Alchemy stones crafted via the above recipe x1
Brimming Essence of Aether x1

※ Processing (Manufacture) Resplendent Vell's Heart x1 and Brimming Essence of Aether x1 via Simple Alchemy grants Vell's Heart x1 and Resplendent Alchemy Stone of Destruction x1.

- How to Obtain: Processing (Manufacture) - Simple Alchemy with the following materials

- Materials #1:
Faint Essence of Aether x1
Sharp Black Crystal Shard x20

- Materials #2:
Faint Essence of Aether x1
Oquilla Piece of the Old Moon x2

- How to Obtain: Complete the daily quest [Repeat] Strategy to Get the Blueprint

- Heat this item to extract Ancient Spirit's Crystal - Viper.

※ This is a functional costume and does not share the set effect with outfits.
※ The effects of this costume cannot be stacked with the Outfit Slot Equip Effect.

933420.name: [Agent] Serendian Smith Garb
933420.description:
A suit for male Serendian smiths. It comes with a tool belt.

※ If you use an Equipment Tailoring Coupon, you will get the same item as a costume, with an additional effect of Amity +15%. This costume can then be equipped in the outfit slot.

If you exchange it for a costume, you cannot register it on the Central Market.
